tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rje rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so/ /dge'o// na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ sangs rgyas kun dngos 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes kyang / /'gro ba'i don du yongs 'dzin tshul bstan pa'i/ /rnam thar mdor bsdus bdag gis brjod par bya/ /'phags yul gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gangs can skye bo'i tshogs kyi don slad du/ /phun tshogs rigs rus cho 'brang ldan pa yis/ /dbang 'byor skye ba bzung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa'i gnas rten chen po'i rnam 'phrul bstan/ /mkhas grub byang chub rtse mos byin brlabs kyis/ /dpag med ngo mtshar bltas bzang legs bstan te/ /lhums nas byung bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byis pa'i dus na'ang dge ba'i ngang tshul can/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis mngon par 'phags/ /sngon sbyangs bag chags gsal bar sad pa yis/ /rtsol med gnas lnga rig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i dus su dpal ldan bir+wa pa/ /dge bsnyen dpal ldan chos skyong zhes su grags/ /rab tu byung tshe kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang por mtshan gsol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs spyod rten la bcas dang rang bzhin gyi/ /nyes ltung dri mas nam yang ma gos shing / /bslab gsum yon tan rin chen mdzod mnga' ba/ /dge sbyong mchog du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro mang don du byang chub thugs bskyed de/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa rlabs chen 'dzin/ /bsdu dngos rnam bzhis 'gro rnams smin mdzad pa/ /rgyal sras thu bor gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor cher zhugs nas/ /dbang dang gdams pa khyod thugs smin cing grol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rin chen gtso bo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg mchog bshes gnyen du ma nyer bsten nas/ /dbang dang rigs gtad rjes gnang rab 'byams dang / /mdo rgyud man ngag de 'brel bstan bcos rnams/

/mtha' dag gsan cing mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rim gnyis zung 'jug rnam grol chu bo'i rgyun/ /g.yel med ngang nas thun mtshams rnal 'byor dang / /legs bshad rin chen phreng ba du ma yis/ /gdul bya smin grol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa'i gnas mchog bu le'i gangs khrod du/ /lam 'bras brgyud pa phal cher zhal gzigs shing / /gzhon nu'i dus na rje btsun gong ma lnga/ /zhal gzigs bstod pa mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyad par sa chen bla mas byin gyis brlabs/ /rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan las/ /rgyud gsum man ngag bcas pa zab mo'i gnad/ /gsan nas thugs su chud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phag mos theg pa mchog la khrid/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje mngon sum lung bstan mdzad/ /khyad par bla ma mchog gi byin rlabs kyis/ /phun tshogs rtogs pa 'khrungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gzhan sngon dang phyi ma'i skye ba mkhyen/ /bar do sgrib med gzigs nas rjes su 'dzin/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul du ma yang yang du/ /legs par ston mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun bsnyel ba med pa'i gzungs thob cing / /dman pa'i kha zas bdud rtsi dngos su bsgyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshe yang dang yang / /me tog char chen 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma hā ka las khyod kyi bka' bzhin bsgrub/ /zhing skyong chen pos sku tshe'i bar chad gsal/ /k+ṣe ṭa pa las chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /bsrungs ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla mas rang bas lhag pa'i sras su gzigs/ /bstan la dga' ba'i lha'i zhabs 'bring byed/ /gdug pa can rnams drag pos tshar gcod mdzad/ /kun gyis skur 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmi lam dbang thob 'khrul pa'i dri ma bral/ /nyid kyi sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims dri bsung kun nas 'phro ba'i sku/

/theg mchog ston pa yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /sgrib med mkhyen brtse phun tshogs lwa ba'i thugs/ /mi zad yon tan gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la ci 'dod chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis bgegs dang bar chad sel/ /mchog dang thun mong gsol ba btab bzhin grub/ /phrin las phun tshogs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i khyon rnams 'ja' tshon 'dra bas khyab/ /dpag yas me tog dkar po'i char chen phab/ /rtse gcig rten 'brel zab mo'i ngang nyid las/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ring bsrel du ma byin rlabs rten du gnang / /dad ldan smin byed zab mos tshim par mdzad/ /skal bzang 'ga' la 'khor lo bde mchog gi /rnam pas rjes su 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa yis/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla med mchod pa'i sprin/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji lta bas/ /'jam dbyangs chos rje rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /thog med sdig pa mtha' dag bshags par bgyi/ /dri med 'phrin las kun la rjes yi rang / /dpag med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mtha' med bskal pa'i bar du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /kun dga'i gsung rab dri med rtag nyan cing / /yid 'ong sku yi rgyal mtshan lta ba dang / /de yi 'phrin las dpal 'byor bzang po yis/ /rtag tu bdag dang 'gro kun skyong bar shog /chu pho khyi yi dbyar zla rwa ba yi/ /yar tshes lnga la bltams pa nas bzung nas/ /me pho 'brug gi ston zla rwa ba yi/ /nyi shu brgyad la mya ngan 'das kyi bar/ /rnam par thar pa yid bzhin nor bu las/ /legs par bris nas mdo tsam bsngags pa 'di/ /nyi ma'i mtshan can bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /bskul nas dpal ldan chos skyong bzang pos sbyar/ /'di dag gi don rgyas par gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ kho bos byas pa'i rnam par thar pa rgyas pa las shes par bya'o// //shu bhaṃ// ༄༅/ /na mo ma hā gu ru/

mañdzu gho ṣaṃ kirti shrī/ dī na ma a nan+ta dh+wa dza shrī bha tra pa ta la bh+nadhā naṃ ka ro mi/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub bstan lhun po'i zom la gnas bcas dam chos 'dul ba'i bdud rtsi'i nying khus blo gros lus chen rab tu rgyas/ /sgra tshad zung gi ra rtse mngon mtho mkhyen brtse'i mig gi nyi zla rab 'char lung rigs gnam lcags mchu sder can/ /mdo rgyud zung gi shog rlabs g.yo bas rgol ngan rgya mtsho rnam par 'dar byed log ma 'khyog 'gro'i dbang po kun/ /lta ngan gtsug rgyan nor bu dang bcas pa kun nas mthar byed mkha' lding dbang po 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal gyur cig /'gro kun dga' mdzad rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin mtshan ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /khyed kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' dpog par ga la nus/ /de lta mod kyi skal bzang 'gro ba'i dbul ba ma lus sel ba'i slad/ /rnam thar yid bzhin nor bu 'di ni dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor sbyin/ /the tshom som nyi'i mig ni zum byas shing / /dad pa'i spu long kun nas g.yo ba dang / /bstod tshig glu dbyangs sgrog pas gsol btab nas/ /srid zhi'i dge legs mtha' dag 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'dir/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang / dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje phul du byung ba mnga' ba'i bdag nyid/ dus gsum gzigs pa sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo/ theg gsum ston pa dam chos kun gyi 'byung gnas/ bslab gsum 'dzin pa dge 'dun kun gyi gtsug rgyan/ sa gsum na 'gran zla bral ba/ srid gsum gyi 'gro ba 'dren pa/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen po chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal/ mtshan gnyis pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid/

nges pa'i don du/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad zin kyang / dag pa dang ma dag pa'i sems can rnams la/ sprul pa mchog dang mchog ma yin pa du ma zhig bstan nas/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa yin te/ rgyud las/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / /zhes dang / rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta ba/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su gzung dmigs nas/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas so/ /de'i phyir rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad pa dang / phrin las thams cad rje btsun 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa dang 'phrin las yin pa'i phyir na/ de dag gi rnam par thar pa su zhig gis brjod par nus/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas nyid dam gdul bya yis/ /dri la ji ltar 'os par 'bab/ /ces pa'i tshul du/ 'dir ni 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya du ma'i snang ngor/ slob pa lam la gnas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can gyi tshul bzung ba'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig brjod par bya'o/ /'di la zhing 'dir skye ba brnyes pa'i khyad par lung rtogs kyi yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba/ 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan pa'i skye gnas phun sum tshogs par sku skye ba bzhes pa yin no/ /de la yon tan bdun ni/ ji skad du/ rigs ldan gzugs bzang longs spyod che/ /shes rab phun tshogs dbang phyug ldan/ /nad med shin tu tshe ring ba/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun dang ldan/ /zhes pa'o/ /de yang / che ba'i yon tan dang po rigs phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rje 'di nyid kyi yab kyi rigs ni/ sna nam zhang zhes bya ba/ bod kyi chos rgyal chen po rim par byon pa rnams kyi zhang blon chen po'i rgyud pa rigs 'di nyid la/

sngar yang / mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa lo tsā ba chen po zhang ye shes sde sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug zhang g.yu brag pa la sogs pa/ dam pa mang po byon pa'i rigs rgyud la/ mkhas grub zul phyar dang / phyug po dpal ldan bzang po la sogs pa sku mched lnga pho brang gad pa steng zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ phyug po dpal ldan bzang po la/ sras dpon chen dpal ldan 'bum dang / phyug po nor 'bum la sogs pa sku mched lnga byon pa'i/ nor 'bum gyi sras/ dbon po nor 'phel zhes bya ba/ rang bzhin gyis ngang rgyud bzang ba/ dad pa dang / shes rab che ba/ g.yo sgyu dang zol zog spangs/ dge sbyor la ngang gis brtson pa/ dkon mchog gi zhabs tog rtse gcig du sgrub cing / gzhan dag gis dkon mchog gi rdzas la gnod pa byas pa lta bu la/ na bza' brdabs pa tsam gyis kyang / pu tra 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i nus mthu dang ldan pa de nyid dang / yum gyi rigs btsan pa 'od bsrung gi gdung rgyud gdong nag jo bor grags pa'i bu sring mo ma gcig rdo rje 'bum zhes bya ba/ rang bzhin gyis shes rab che zhing / dkon mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang / snying rje la sogs pa yon tan du ma dang ldan pa/ gsol ras byin pa dang / byin rlabs byas pa tsam gyis/ gdon gyis brlabs pa dang / lkugs pa la sogs pa'i skyon las grol ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa de gnyis kyi sras su skye ba bzhes te/ lcags mo bya'i lo la lhums su zhugs par gyur to/ /de'i tshe yang yum la mi bde ba cung zad kyang med cing / dad pa dang snying rje la sogs pa sngar las kyang lhag par che ba la sogs pa yon tan du ma 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / bla ma dz+nyā na mi tra zhes bya ba'i gdam pa gcig bzhugs pa la/ yum gyi dmar khrid gsan pa'i tshe/ chos nyan gyi grogs la/ sgrub chen ma bzang mo gcig kyang yod pas/ tho rangs kyi cha la sgrub chen ma de yum chen mo dang dbu sngas bsres nas/

mnal cung zad mdzad pa'i tshe/ sgrub chen ma'i mnal lam du/ gnas brtan yan lag 'byung bzhugs pa'i gnas yin zer ba'i rin po che'i brag ri chen po gcig la/ khong gis dbu sngas gtad pa gsal po byung nas/ sad pa na/ yum chen mo la spro ba bskyed par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas grub chen po/ lo chen byang rtse zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi drung du/ yum gyis mjal ba la byon nas/ gsol gyi rnam grangs du mas mnyes par byas pa'i tshe/ rje de nyid kyis zhal du thog mar bzhes/ yum chen mo'i zhal du phyag gis btab/ bu chung gi skal ba yang zo zhig gsungs nas/ yang phyag gis gnang bar mdzad cing / slar yang de lta bu'i tshul gyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim par bzhes nas/ 'di la bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can gcig 'byung bas/ shin tu gces spras su gyis shig ces gdams par mdzad do/ /der ma zad/ rje 'di nyid lhums su 'jug pa'i rten 'brel yang grub chen 'di nyid kyis bsgrigs pa yin no/ /zhes kyang thos so/ /de nas gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar/ ti shri kun dga' blo gros kyi gzims khang mthong smon bla brang du/ rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo/ snron gyi zla ba'i tshes lnga'i nub mo skar ma lag pa la babs pa na mkha' la rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par shar ba'i tshe/ phyag phyi bas mar me khyer yong pa dang mnyam du rje nyid sku bltams par gyur ro/ /de'i tshe/ sngon ston pa sangs rgyas bltams pa na/ gter lnga brgya kha phye ba dang / rgod ma lnga brgya la rte'u skyes pa dang mtshungs par/ lung pa'i phur sngar med pa'i chu rdol ba dang / rgod ma la rte'u skyes pa la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i ltas du ma byung ngo / /de nas sku'i rnam 'gyur rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa dang 'dra ba/ rgyu mtshan du byas nas/

rje'i mtshan bir+wa pa zhes rje de nyid kyi khu bos btags so/ /'di ltar ji ltar dag pa'i lha lam yangs pa ni/ /rgyu skar 'khor lo yongs su gang ba ltar/ /'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khyon gyi nam mkha' 'dir/ /dge legs skar tshogs bye ba shar bar gyur/ /ji ltar zas gtsang sras po bltams pa'i tshe/ /phun tshogs dge mtshan lhun gyis grub pa ltar/ /ngo mtshar ltas bzang du ma legs bstan te/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal du 'khrungs par gyur/ /yon tan 'od zer bye bas brgyan pa yis/ /khyod sku 'jig rten sgron me bltams pa na/ /thub bstan sa 'dzin phyogs kun gsal ba dang / /nag phyogs mun pa'i phyogs kun bros pa snyam/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //de nas gzhon nu de skyed bsrings pa na/ gzhan las lhag par sku skyed che zhing / smra mkhyen pa na/ saṃ kṛ ta la sogs skad rigs sna tshogs ma bslabs par gsung ba dang / phyag mdzub kyis lan dzā dang / wa rtu la dang / na ga ra la sogs pa'i rgya gar gyi yig rigs du ma 'bri ba dang / byis pa'i khrod du rtse ba na yang / chos 'chad pa dang nyan pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa'i rnam 'gyur la sogs pa/ dge ba'i rnam spyod 'ba' zhig gis dus 'das shing / rje nyid kyi gcung po sogs rtsed rogs kyi byis pa dag gis sems can la gnod pa byas pa na/ bzod med kyi thugs rje dpag tu med pa g.yo ba dang / gzhan yang / zhi ba dang / dul ba dang / gsong por smra ba la sogs pa byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa zhig tu gyur to/ /zhes thos so/ /che ba'i yon tan gnyis pa/ gzugs bzang ba phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rje 'di nyid/ sngon bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i 'bras bu/ sku tshe 'dir yang gzhan las lhag par sku mdzes shing / brjid pa dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa na/

gzhan gyis sgrun du med cing ji tsam du 'khor gyi tshogs che ba dang / 'khor de dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang ba mang du tshogs pa de tsam gyis/ rje 'di nyid gzi brjid lhag par che zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis/ lha la sogs pa'i 'od zer du ma mog mog por mdzad pa lta bu'o/ /che ba'i yon tan gsum pa/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa ni/ mchog gi longs spyod bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems du ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ gzhan gyis phul ba dang / rje rang nyid kyis bzhengs pa du ma dang / de dag gi spyan sngar mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / thun mong gi longs spyod gser dngul gos dar la sogs pa mang du phyag du babs shing de dag phal mo che yang / bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod zla mchod la/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor chen po du ma zhal phye nas/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen cing bkur ba rgya chen po dang / sdug phongs la sbyin pa gtong ba la sogs pa'i phyogs su gtong bar mdzad kyi/ rang gi don du ni/ til tsam yang 'chang bar mi mdzad la/ khyad par du theg chen chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs pa'i dus su/ gdan sa chen por bur btang nyi shu rtsa bzhi bshig pa'i ja bur bzang po zhus/ che 'bul 'os pa rnams la 'bul ba bzang po dang bcas pa'i gral 'gyed mdzad/ khyad par du yang theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ rin po che las grub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ gos bzang po'i rten khebs zung sbrel/ gser zho bzhi bcu'i maṇ+ḍal dngul dam/ dkar gzugs sgor mo btegs bcas/ gos phrug ta hūm̐ gis mthong rings/ ta hūm̐ gis ber thul gos phyi nang / nas khal brgya tham pa la sogs te/ mdor na gser zho nyis brgya tsam gyi thag yong ba'i 'bul ba rgya chen po mdzad/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i drung du/

gdan sa pa'i gang zag gis/ nyin gcig la 'bul ba byas pa la/ 'di las lhag pa ma byung bar grags shing / chos kyi rgyal po chen po yang legs par dgyes nas kun mkhyen dol po ba'i nang mchod kyi kā pa la mtshan ldan gser ljid mnyam blud mar gnang nas/ chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag tu babs pa de nyid kyis thog grangs gnang sbyin bzang po yang mdzad par gnang ngo / /mdor na nor rnams kun gyi nang nas chog shes pa/ /rab mchog lags par lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshul du/ chog shes pa'i phyir nor ni rje 'di las dpal 'byor che ba su yang ma mthong la/ gzhan yang dad dang tshul khrims gtong dang thos pa dang / /dri med ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang / /shes rab nor bdun legs par rgyal bas gsungs/ /nor gzhan phal pa don ma mchis rtogs mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa'i tshul phyag len du thebs par mdzad pa ni/ che ba'i yon tan bzhi pa shes rab phun tshogs pa ni/ sku skye ba snga ma snga ma nas legs par sbyangs pa'i skyes thob dang / sku tshe 'dir yang sbyor byung gis thugs rab phul du phyin pa snga ba la brten nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhyen pa rgyas pa yin te/ de yang bzo rig pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rgyud dang bstan bcos rnam dag las gsungs pa'i sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad dang / de dag so so mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud pas/ sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad la/ rje 'di nyid kyis phyag bris su bkod pa/ kyai'i rdo rje/ bde mchog gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed/ bstan pa'i gtso bo dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'khor byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gis bskor ba dang / rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa'i bris sku du ma zhig snang la/ de lta bu'i phyag bris du ma mdzad pa yang mngon sum du mthong zhing / de dag thams cad kyang phyag tshad skyon med pa dang ldan pas/

lung rigs kyis brgal du med cing / sngon chad gzhan gyis mthong ba lta zhog blo yul du yang ma shar ba'i sku'i nyams dang / rgyan gyi rnam 'gyur la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa du ma zhig rtsol med du 'byung zhing snang la/ rigs gnas 'di nyid la tshe gang du sbyangs zhing mkhas par grags pa dag gis kyang sgrun par mi nus cing / de dag las ches shin tu mgyogs par yang snang ngo / /khyad par du yang / ngam ring du rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i sku phyag ris su mdzad pa dang / 'de gu las grub pa'i bir+wa pa dang dbang ho sha'i sku 'di lta bu'i mtshar ba dang / nyams dang rnam 'gyur 'dra ba ni/ dus gsum khegs par snang ngo zhes mkhas pa dag kha mthun par smra bar byed cing / rdul tshon las/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku phyag bris su mdzad pa zhig bir+wa pa dngos su mthong zer ba'i dzo gi zhig gis mthong ba na/ bla mas bir+wa pa dngos su gzigs 'dug ces gleng bar byed 'dug go /gzhan yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang rab 'byams mtha' yas pa bzhengs pa na/ rje 'di nyid kyis phyag bris mdzad pa'i tshe/ phyag gnyis kas 'bri bar mdzad pas/ gzhan du ma phyogs der bzhag pa las/ rje nyid lhag par mgyogs shing legs la/ khyad par du/ lha khang chen mor theg chen chos kyi rgyal po chen pos bka' gnang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sgrub mchod mdzad pa na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po phyag bris su mdzad de/ gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo rgyan glang gser la sogs pa dang / dur khrod du phyogs skyong dang / zhing skyong dang / grub chen la sogs pa sku yongs su rdzogs pa nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa la sogs pa ri mo'i rnam 'gyur mtha' yas pa mdzad pas/ chos kyi rgyal po'ang / 'byon bzhud mdzad pa'i bar la/ ched du gtad nas yang yang gzigs nas bsngags pa brjod par mdzad cing / dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams kyang mtshar du gyur nas/

spyan mi 'dzum par ngoms pa med pa'i tshul du gzigs shing / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di bas legs pa sngar mthong ma myong zhes sgrog par byed do/ /yi ge'i phyogs la yang / sku skye ba snga ma'i bag chags sad pa'i mthus/ rgya gar gyi yi ge'i rigs mi 'dra ba du ma slob dpon la ma ltos par mkhyen la/ bod kyi yig rigs du ma dang / hor yig la sogs pa yang bstan pa tsam gyis dang / gzigs tsam gyis shin tu legs byang bar mkhyen pa yin te/ rgya bod kyi yig rigs mi 'dra ba du ma phyag ris su mdzad kyin 'dug pa yang mthong la/ rje nyid kyis mkhyen pa'i yi ge rnams kyi tshad/ shog bu'i ngos la legs par bris nas/ dkar chag du bkod pa ni/ ma ga ta'i lañdza dang / rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang / na ga ra/ za hor u ṭi pa na'i yul/ kha che ni dha ri dang / spri yang ku dang wa rtu sogs/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi yi ge dang / /rgya nag yo gur hor yig dang / /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir grags pa sogs/ /yi ge'i 'du byed mthar phyin pa/ /blo gsal 'jam dbyangs grags pa yin/ /'di bzhin 'bri ba'i 'phrul yig mkhan/ /yod na shes bya'i me long la/ /rnam spyod gzugs brnyan gsal bar bris/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso ba rig pa'i dbang du byas na/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa'i rtsa 'grel dang / de dag gi don bsdus pa bod kyi drang srong mkhas pa dag gis byas pa'i gso spyad mtha' dag gi snying po bsdus pa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i gso spyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa yang phyin ci ma log par mkhyen pas/ phal cher ni byin rlabs kyis gdul bya'i nad rnams sel bar mdzad do/ /sgra rig pa'i dbang du byas na/ sgra'i bstan bcos chen po ka la pa dang / tsan+t+ra pa la sogs pa nas/ 'byung ba'i dbyings dang / si sogs dang / ri sogs la sogs pa'i rang bzhin dang / rkyen dang rnam 'gyur la sogs pa sku skye ba snga ma la legs par sbyangs pa'i gnad rnams bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i stobs kyis sku tshe 'dir yang skad dod rigs mi gcig pa du mar nam dgos pa'i dus su zhus pa rnams gsal bar gsung gin 'dug cing /

gzhan yang rje nyid ngam rings na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal ldan nags kyi rin chen de/ bod du byon pa'i tshur res ngam rings su byon/ rje 'di nyid dang mjal/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi gsung gleng dang / chos kyi 'bel gtam mang po mdzad kyin 'dug khyad par du sngon bram ze mchog sred kyis/ ma ga ta rdo rje gdan du/ bstan pa'i gtso bo dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la bstod pa sh+lau ka bcu gnyis mdzad par grags pa'i dang po ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po lha mi'i khyu mchog shin tu zab cing snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis sred pa'i mdud pa rnam par 'grol byed yon tan gter 'dzin chos kyi rgyal por mngon par dbang bskur ba/ /lha'i lhar gyur lha mchog khyod ni sa gsum 'di na mtshungs bral pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ /skyon bral shākya seng ge de la bdag ni rab tu gus pas dus rnams kun tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di paṇa chen gyis thugs la bzhugs kyin 'dug cing / sngar bod du ma 'gyur ba la/ chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog legs pa'i drung nas gsol ba btab nas rje 'di nyid kyis saṃ kṛ ta'i skad las/ bod kyi skad du legs par bsgyur ba yin no/ /de dus lo tsā ba gzhan med pas 'gyur ji lta bu yod dam zhes ma dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig the tshom du gyur pa na/ dus phyis paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de nyid/ skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba chen po mañdzu shrīs phyag phyi byas nas slar yang ngam rings su phebs/ de dus lo tsā ba 'gyur lhag par mkhas pa'i steng du/ paṇa chen nyid kyis kyang bod skad shin tu mkhas par mkhyen gyin 'dug pas/ bstod pa 'di'i 'gyur la zhus dag mdzad pa na/ bcos dgos phra mo tsam yang ma byung zhing / 'gyur shin tu legs so zhes bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad pas/ thams cad yid ches par gyur to/ /gtan tshigs rig pa'i dbang du byas nas/

don gyis 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa legs par mkhyen cing / sde bdun gyi snying po tshad ma rig pa'i gter rang 'grel dang bcas pa yang mkhas par mdzad nas/ yang dag pa'i rigs pa seng ge'i nga ros/ phas rgol glang po che myos pa'i klad pa 'gems par nus pas/ ston pa shin tu bzang bar gyur nas/ mtshan yang 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal zhes pa/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos gnang ba yin no/ /nang rig pa'i dbang du byas na/ sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang du byas pa'i gzhung lugs du ma zhig thugs su chud cing mkhyen par mdzad pa ste/ rgyas par ni 'chad par 'gyur ba las shes so/ /gzhan yang sdeb sbyor dang / snyan ngag dang / ming gi mngon brjod la sogs pa'i rig gnas phra mo rnams dang / 'ga' zhig ni sngon gyi bag chags sad pas ma bslabs par mkhyen cing / 'ga' zhig ni dka' tshegs med par mkhyen nas/ mkhyen pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /mdor na skyes stobs kyi thugs rab bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas/ sku gzhon nu'i dus su yang / tshad ma rigs gter gyi gzhung nang gcig la thugs su chud par mdzad pa dang / bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs nang gcig la zin pa la sogs pa'i 'dzin bzang ba dang / lan gcig thugs su chud gting bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba dang / don spyod kyi thugs rab kyang gzhan las rno ba dang / gsal ba dang / zab par gyur pa yin no/ /che ba'i yon tan lnga pa/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rje 'di nyid cho rigs phun sum tshogs par 'khrungs pa la brten nas sku gzhon nu'i dus su'ang / thams cad kyi gzhan dang ma mnyam pa'i bskur bsti mdzad cing / sku yon tan mthar son pa na/ 'jig rten 'dir sku che ba sa skya 'khon gyi gdung brgyud du ma dang / gu'i gung chos grags dpal bzang po yab sras dang / ta'i si tu lha btsun skyabs pa la sogs pa/

lho byang gi sde bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dbus gtsang gi mi chen du mas/ rje nyid kyi zhabs la gtugs cing / chos phyogs nas sku che ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang la mang bas/ bla mar bzung nas gtsug gis rgyan dam par 'dzin pa yin te/ rgyas par ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ theg chen chos kyis rgyal po chen pos kyang / kā pa la mtshan ldan gnang ba'i dus su chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan par/ mtshan gsol rje nyid kyi sku mdun du'ang bzhugs gdan bzang po gong nas gong du spor ba la sogs pa mdzad pa yin no/ /che ba'i yon tan drug pa/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rje 'di nyid kyi sku la/ snyung rkyen glo bur ba gang gis kyang gos pa med cing gdul bya'i snang ngor 'gul cham byung ba lta bu'i tshul ston pa yang / sems can 'dul ba'i dbang gis de ltar du ston pa yin te/ res 'ga' gsol sman bzhes pa'i tshul yang ston mod/ phal cher ni thugs dam dang / yi dam la gsol ba btab pas sel bar mdzad la/ zhabs kyi snyung gzhi shin tu lci bar ljen cher gnang ba yod kyang / rang rgyud pa ma yin par mngon te/ chos 'khor ma bskor ba'i skabs su/ snyung ba'i rnam pa ston pa la/ chos 'khor tshugs nas thabs gzhan ci yang mi dgos par dwangs 'gro ba dang / dbang bskur 'ga' zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ bdag skyed mdzad dus/ snyung zug shin tu che ba/ reg mi bzod pa lta bur snang ba la/ dbang dngos gzhi'i tshe bzhengs nas/ dbang rdzas bde blag tu 'brim par mdzad pa mngon sum du mthong bas so/ /de bas na/ gdul bya skal dman dag gi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ snyung ba'i tshul bstan pa 'ba' zhig tu nges so/ /che ba'i yon tan bdun pa/ sku tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rje 'di nyid sku tshe'i tshad las lhag par bzhugs pa yin te/ de'i phyir tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de yang dang por rje nyid 'khrungs pa'i dus su/

mngon shes smra ba dang 'dra ba'i rtsis mkhan mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis rtsis byas pas/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gnyis las mi thub par lung bstan pa la/ rje nyid kyi thugs dam gyi dbang gis lo gsum bsring pa yin te/ zhal nas kho bo la/ khyed slob ma rnams kyis/ rim 'gro byas pa dang / nga rang gi dge sbyor gyis lo gsum bsrings pa yin/ zhes gsungs shing bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe yang / yum chen mo'i zhal nas/ chos rje pa thos bsam sgom gsum 'phrin las thams cad mthar phyin sku tshe'i tshad las lhag par bzhugs pa yin gsung nas/ thugs khral ci yang mi mdzad par snang ngo / /mdor na rigs dang / gzugs dang / longs spyod dang / thugs rab dang / dbang phyug dang / snyun med pa dang / sku tshe mthar phyin pa ste/ che ba'i yon tan bdun gyis mngon par 'phags pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ rigs rus phun tshogs chu shel khams las grub/ /yon tan yar ngo'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /khyod sku zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa/ /dpal 'byor ri dwags mtshan mas rnam par mdzes/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i 'od dkar drwa ba yis/ /shes bya'i nam mkha' khyab par gyur pa na/ /chen dgu'i gza' skar rnam par bkra ba yis/ /dbus su mngon par mtho zhing lham mer gsal/ /nyer 'tshe'i sgra gcan skyon las rnam grol zhing / /dus min 'chi ba'i mun tshogs rnam par gsal/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis legs brgyan pa/ /sngon med rgyu skar bdag po khyed la 'dud/ /ces pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa lung rtogs kyi yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ gzhi tshul khrims ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul/ lung gi yon tan thos bsam ji ltar mdzad pa/ bsgoms byung rtogs pa yon tan 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po/ gzhi tshul khrims la ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul ni/ sdom pa gsum gyis rgyud mdzes par byas te/ de yang so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i dbang du byas nas/

dgung lo lnga bzhes pa'i dus su/ dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa nod de/ bir+wa'i mtshan rnal ma yin gsungs nas/ dpal ldan chos skyong du mtshan rtags/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pas mkhan po mdzad/ sems dpa' chen po dz+nya na mi tra bas slob dpon mdzad de/ dad pa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su dge tshul mdzad/ de dus mkhan po'i zhal nas/ sngon chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po la yang / byis pa'i dus nyid nas saṃ kṛ ta'i skad gsung ba dang / rgya gar gyi yi ge du ma 'bri ba la sogs pa rang byung du byung bar 'dug de bzhin du bu 'di la yang byung ba yin pas/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i mtshan dngos/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes pa yin pas/ der thogs shig gsungs nas/ de bzhin du mtshan gsol/ dgung lo nyi shur phebs pa dang / theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos mkhan po/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pas las slob/ bla ma blo gros dpal bas gsang ston mdzad nas/ dad pa'i dge 'dun nyi shu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa nod par mdzad de/ bslab par bya ba'i gnas shin tu phra mo tshun chad/ spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar shin tu gces par bsrungs nas/ nyes ltung phra zhing phra bas kyang ma gos par mdzad de/ tshul khrims kyi dri bzang bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing / dge tshul dang dge sbyong brgya phrag du ma'i mkhan slob mdzad nas/ rgyud smin par mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzhon nu nyid nas dbu ma lugs kyi thugs bskyed dang sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed gsan cing / de dag gis bslab bya ston pa'i gzhung / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa dang / bslab pa kun las btus pa la sogs pa yang gsan cing mkhyen par mdzad la/ man ngag kyang / skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim pa dang / theg chen blo sbyong dang /

zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa'i 'khrid du ma gsan nas/ byams pa tshad med pa sngon du 'gro ba'i snying rje rlabs po ches grangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'jug pa'i ngang nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas/ gzhan don rgya chen po sgrub par mdzad pa zhig ste/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs ni/ /srog gi phyir yang mi btang ngo / /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' thos mang dang / /bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyo med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / bshes gnyen dul ba zhi zhing nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag par brtson byas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la rten/ /de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /bsnyen par rab grags chog bzang shes ldan yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par smra ba yin pa ste/ /bshad pas skye bo'i nang du nyi ma bzhin du bltams/ /zhes sogs theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ston pa'i lung gi brjod bya'i don thams cad thugs rgyud la tshang bar mdzad nas gdul bya dpag tu med pa la byang chub kyi sa bon 'debs par yang mdzad do/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang dang rigs gtad rjes gnang phal mo che gsan cing / de dag gi lam gyi gtso bo thugs dam du bzhes te/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la shin tu gces spras su mdzad nas bskyangs pa'i mthus/ blo ldan slob mas bla mar ni/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs shing chags la ma gdams dang / /bcom dang bcas par mi bya'o/ /rten zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/

/snying brtser ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /sngags bshad pa'i spyod pa shes/ /rab tu dwangs shing dbang po dul/ /ces dang / zhi ba la sogs las la byang / /sngags dang rnal 'byor cho ga shes/ /cho ga nyi shu bya bar brlabs/ /de ni bla mar mngon par brjod/ /tshul khrims dag cing sbyin par gtong / /bzod dang brtson 'grus mchog tu ldan/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsgom la zhen/ /shes rab ldan zhing bzod la mkhas/ /bla ma'i phyir ni yon tan rdzogs/ /dpal ldan slob dpon zhes ni brjod/ /nang gi gsang 'dus las rab dga'/ /phyi rol nyan thos la spyod pa/ /de lta'i man ngag rim pa yis/ /slob ma rnams la rjes su bslab/ /de ni bstod par yongs su shes/ /zhes dang / dul zhing zab mo'i chos dang ldan/ /rig pa thams cad mkhas par byas/ /sbyin bsreg dkyil 'khor sngags shes shing / /rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son/ /de nyid bcu ni rnam par rig /nyan thos spyod pa srung ba po/ /sngags spyod rim par gus pa dang / /gzugs ldan mthong na dga' ba dang / /dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing ltas par ldan/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'joms pa po/ /sngags dang lus skyob sbyor ba yis/ /'jig rten rnams ni bde bar byed/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa rgyud sde rnams nas bshad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis spang bya'i mtshan nyid kun dang bral zhing / blang bya'i mtshan nyid ma tshang ba med pa mnga' ba'i sgo nas/ skal ldan du ma yang smin grol gyi lam zab mo la dgod par mdzad pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims khor yug dbus na rnam spyod nor bu'i tshogs kyis legs bltams bsam gtan chu gter 'khyil ba'i klong / /dge slong chos kyi gling bzhis rab mdzes sems bskyed phyin drug gser gyi ri bdun gzhan phan gzi 'od khor yug can/ /rgyal sras klu dbang bye ba'i 'jug ngogs byams brtse'i rlabs ldan rol mtsho'i dbus na smin byed rin chen khams las grub/

/rgyud sde bzhi'i bang rim mtho ldan rim gnyis bla re ska rags rab 'chang gsum ldan lhun po'i dbang por 'dud/ /ces bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa lung gi yon tan thos bsam ji ltar mdzad tshul ni/ rje 'di nyid/ sku na gzhon nu la klog slob pa'i dus la bab pa na/ yum chen mo'i dgongs pa la/ bu chung 'di la slob dpon mkhas pa dang tshugs bzang ba/ spyod lam tshun chod kyis slob yar legs po yong pa gcig dgos par 'dug pas slob dpon su'i drung du bzhag na legs sam dgongs pa dang snyam du/ bo dong gi mkhas pa chen po kun dga' bzang po zhes bya ba de nyid sa bzang du chos rje byang seng ba la/ sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung gsan pa la byon pa dang 'dzoms/ yum chen mo dang sngar zhal 'dris yod pas dkon khang bla brang du gdan 'dren zhus/ sras kyi klog dpon mdzad par gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin zhal gyis bzhes nas/ de ka nas phyag phyir byon te/ klog brlabs pas/ tshegs med du mkhyen/ klog gtar rnam 'grel gyi gzhung la mdzad pas/ ring por ma thogs par thugs su chud/ de nas slob dpon de nyid kyi phyag phyir dpal e chos 'byung gi chos grwa chen por byon nas/ sde snod kyi gsan sbyong mang po mdzad/ khyad par du rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel shin tu mkhas par mdzad/ zhal nas kho bo lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i dus/ chos rje lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i sku drung du mjal/ tshad ma'i bgro gleng gyis gsung / de dus mi skyar yod pas/ sog spang gcig la chos gos kyis dod byas/ chos rje'i drung du bgro gleng zhus pas/ shin tu mnyes par byung gsung / dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa la/ gdan sa chen por grwa bskor mdzad/ de nas 'gran zla bral ba'i mkhas pa chen po/ g.yag ston chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas dpal gyi zhabs la gtugs te/ dbus la 'byon pa'i phyag phyir yang byon/

spyir byams chos lnga yis thog drangs sde snod rin po che du ma gsan sbyong mdzad/ khyad par du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la shin tu mkhas par mdzad pa yin te/ de yang rje'i zhal nas/ kho bo mkhan chen g.yag pa'i drung na yod dus/ mkhan chen pa'i phar phyin gyi ṭī ka chen po rtsom pa mdzad kyin 'dug pa/ yig mkhan yang long chen po rang mi 'dug cing / mkhan chen pa'ang 'phral thugs spro thung bar snang ba gcig yod pas/ bka' bkyon yang yang gnang dgos pa/ 'gor che rab yod pa'i rnam pa gcig byung / de dus mkhan chen pa'i zhal nas/ dbon po nyid shes rab che zhing yi ge mkhas/ khyad par du phar phyin la go ba legs po yod pas/ nyid kyis yig mkhan byas na e yong / yig yon gcig dang byed gsung / kho bos de ltar na yig mkhan shin tu yang bgyid yig yon la gzhan gnang mi 'tshal/ bdag rang la phar phyin gyis mdzub khrid zab pa tshar gcig zhu zer ba zhus pa/ 'o na mdzub khrid cis kyang byed pas thog mar yig mkhan mdzod cig ces gsung nas/ kho bo la mkhan chen pa nyid kyis mdo sbyor ro/ /'grel pa 'grel bshad rgya bod kyi bshad pa'i na yams so so dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas pa'i chos thun che ba re gsungs/ kho bos blo yul du nges par byas nas/ tshig gi phreng ba tshun chad mkhan chen pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin/ zhag gnyis gsum re bris/ yang chos tshar re nyan gyis bris pa de lta bu byas/ de dus mkhan chen pa rtsom pa mdzad 'phro la sku cung zad dub pa na/ sku khams gso ba'i rnal cung zad re mdzad pa dang sad dus phal che ba re mdzad pa la/ yang kho bos dga' ldan du phyin/ rje btsun byams pa dang mjal zhes yang yang gsung ba gcig yod/ de nas ṭīka chen gyi brtsom pa yongs su rdzogs par grub pa na/ kho bo'i blo la yang tshang bar zin 'dug de nas mkhan chen pa'i zhal nas/ da yig yon gyis mdzub khrid byed gsung ba la/

thugs la btags pa lags na/ ṭīka chen blo la tshud bdog pas/ zhu mi 'tshal bar gda' lags zer ba zhus pas/ de ltar na'ang kha sing dam bcas pa yin pas/ cis kyang byed dgos gsung nas/ mdzub khrid kyang tshang bar mdzad ces gsungs/ spyir mkhas grub kun bzang pa de nyid lo bdun brgyad bsten nas/ blo sbyong don bdun ma cha lag dang bcas pa dang / 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo bsgrub pa'i rjes snang / gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rjes snang sa lugs/ rnam 'joms kyi rigs gtad sa lugs/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang / dril bu pa'i dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rjes snang / bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa/ ku ru kul+le'i gsang bsgrub kyi rjes snang / man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang rgyud man ngag rwa lo chen po'i dkar chag ltar tshang ma chos skyong che chung gi rjes gnang bsgrub thabs las tshogs man ngag dang bcas pa/ tshang bar gsan cing / thog mar bka' drin che ba'i bla ma yin ces mos gus rgya chen po mdzad do/ /rgya bod kun gyi gtsug rgyan/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i drung du/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/ tshogs bshad ma cha lag dang bcas pa/ rten 'brel snying po'i 'khrid/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i dbang / rjes snang / gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang / de'i dbang gong ma/ rim lnga'i dmar khrid/ nag khrid cha lag dang bcas pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dbang / dgra nag sa lugs/ rwa lugs/ skyo lugs/ zhwa lugs rnams kyi dbang / 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang / gshed dmar lha lnga dang / bcu gsum ma'i dbang / bskyed pa'i rim pa/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa shin tu spros med/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang / dril bu lha lnga'i dbang / dril bu lus dkyil kyi dbang /

rims lnga'i 'khrid dbyibs dang bcas pa/ phag mo lha so bdun ma'i dbang / dus kyi 'khor lo rwa lugs dang / 'brom lugs kyi dbang / rgyud 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od/ sbyor ba yan lag drug lugs du ma dang bcas pa/ kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi yab bka'/ yum bka'/ so so'i lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i dbang / gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag dbyibs cha lag phra mo dang bcas pa/ lam bskor dgu dang / mkhas pa sgo drug gi 'khrid la sogs pa/ phran tshegs du ma dang bcas pa dang / khyad par du rgyud gsum 'grel pa dang bcas pa legs par gsan nas/ thugs su chud pa na/ chos kyi rgyal po chen pos bka' gnang nas/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ drung skor du ma yang chos nyan du bcug ta dben chos rgyal ba'i drung gi na bza' ber thul legs pa gcig gnang nas/ rje nyid dgung lo bcu bdun pa la/ gdan sa chen por/ rgyud gsum thugs bshad mdzad nas gsungs/ gzhan yang / kye rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang / mtsho skyes lugs kyi dbang / gur rigs bsdus rnams kyi dbang rnams dang / rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung / dmar po bskor gsum gyi rjes gnang / so so'i man ngag dang bcas pa/ mgon po lha lnga ma'i dbang / lugs gnyis/ lha brgyad ma/ lha bcu gnyis ma/ lha bcu bdun ma rnams kyi dbang / rjes gnang / gnod sbyin lcam dral/ pu tra ming sring / dkar bdud rnams kyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa la sogs pa du ma zhig gsan cing / mdor na theg chen chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i zhal snga nas/ so sor thar pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa gsum ka nod/ de dag par rjes su 'brel ba'i bshad pa/ phyag len rgyud/ man ngag dang bcas pa'i bka' drin mtha' yas pa nod nas/ bla ma kun gyi nang nas kyang / rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo ltar lhag par mtho ba'i gtsug gi rgyan dam par bzhugs pa'i tshul gyis/

mos gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad cing / zhal bzhugs pa'i tshe yang / bka' bzhin bsgrub pa dang / 'phral nyer mkho'i phyag phyi yang / ci rigs pa bsgrubs la/ zhabs tog gi gtso bo 'chad nyan sgom bsgrub/ chos kyi rgyal po dgongs pa ji ltar mdzad cing / sku 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas kyang / mchod 'bul zla mchod/ dus mchod sogs bzang zhing / rgya che ba bsgrubs pa dang / de dag gi thad du yang / rje 'di nyid spyan chab char ltar du g.yo ba lta bu'i mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs par mdzad cing / me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa'i ltas bzang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang 'byung zhing gnang la/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po chen pos kyang / thugs brtse ba chen pos legs par bskyangs/ thugs kyi sras dam par 'dzin cing / zhal nas kyang / bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'di/ skyes thob dang / sbyangs stobs kyi shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan/ rigs pa'i gnas phal mo che khong du chud cing / lung rtogs kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i/ nus pa yod pa gcig yin/ zhes bstod bskur bsngags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang nas yang du mdzad par gnang la/ mya ngan las 'das kyang / rje 'di nyid kyi rnal lam du yang yang byon nas/ thugs the tshom gyi drwa ba sel ba dang / lung ston pa dang / bka' bsgo ba la sogs pa yang 'byung ba zhig go /gzhan yang / dge sdings pa bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du/ kyai'i rdo rje 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang dang / gsang 'dus mi skyod rdo rje'i dbang dang / bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang gsan nas/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs par/ chos kyi rgyal po chen pos gsan pa'i phyag phyi mdzad nas gsan/ zhang zhe dgon pa la/ rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gsan/ bla ma dge dpal la/

blo sbyong mtshon cha 'khor lo dang / rma bya dug 'joms gnyis gsan/ chos rje byang seng ba la/ grub thob brgyad cu'i byin rlabs dang / bstod pa/ gzhan yang / phag gur gshin rje brgyad sogs rjes gnang dang phran tshegs mang du gsan/ bo dong pa bla ma 'jam dkar ba la/ rgyal sras bka' 'bum sogs gsan/ mdo sngags rab 'byams kyi bdag po sa bzang pa/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi drung du blo sbyong chos bshad ma/ glang ri thang pa'i tshig rkang brgyad ma/ rigs gsum spyi dbang / 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dkar po'i rjes gnang / gdugs dkar can gyi dbang / rta mgrin jo bo lugs dang / sho na bzhi bskor gnyis kyi dbang / bsgrub bskor cha lag bcas pa/ rdo rje dbyings/ khams gsum rnam rgyal/ rtse mo rigs bsdus/ dpal mchog rdor sems dang / rigs bsdus gnyis/ nam mkha' dri med chen mo/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ sdom 'byung sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ kyai'i rdo rje 'grel pa lugs rnams kyi dbang / de dag kyang 'grel pa'i rgya gzhung / bod gzhung du ma'i lung / rdo rje phreng ba dang / kri ya sa mu tsa'i dbang lung / rdo rje snying 'grel la sogs pa brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa bcu gcig gi thog grangs/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa du ma'i lung / gzhan yang kha ba can du 'gyur ro cog gi rgyud gzungs bsdus/ mdo mangs rnams dang / dbu ma bstod tshogs la sogs pa/ rgya gzhung bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lung / bka' lung rab 'byams kyi bdag po/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub pa'i drung du/ rigs gsum spyi'i rigs gtad/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang / brgya rtsa'i rjes snang dang / lung / rnam rgyal gyi rjes snang / tshe dpag med dze ta ri dang / 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang / grub rgyal ma'i dbang / tshe 'khrid man ngag dang bcas pa/ mi la'i lugs tshe dbang man ngag

sman mo lnga pa'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ rnam 'joms mdze ta ri'i lugs dang / dz+nyā na shrī'i lugs kyi rigs gtad/ rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs kyi rjes gnang / rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang rnams dang / kun rig rdo rje dbyings/ khams gsum rnam rgyal/ rtse mo/ dpal mchog mi 'khrugs pa'i rnam 'joms sa lugs/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ gtsug dgu 'jam dpal gsang ldan/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu ma/ phyag rdor/ 'khor chen/ gtum mo mi g.yo ba/ bla med rnams kyi dbang / khro bo reg tshig gi dbang / chos bskor/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma/ lus dkyil/ snyan sgrol rnams kyi dbang / sgrol ma nyer gcig gi dbang / rjes gnang / chos bskor cha lag dang bcas pa/ bde mchog lū hi pa/ a bh+ya'i lugs/ lwa ba pa'i lugs/ kha che lugs/ sa lugs/ bde mchog nag po pa/ dril bu pa/ bde mchog dkar po/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ sgyu thod/ gdan gsum rnams kyi dbang / bde mchog dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi byin rlabs/ phag mo zhal gsum gyi byin rlabs cha lag dang bcas/ phag mo mar lugs/ phag mo kur ma pa ti/ phag mo khros nag bka' gter rnams kyi rjes gnang / chos bskor/ kyai rdor mtsho skyes lugs/ nag po lugs/ sam+pu ṭi/ rdor dbyings/ kyai rdor mtshon cha can/ sa lugs dang nag po lugs gnyis kyi dbang / rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang rjes gnang dang / lung dang / gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan no/ /de'i phyir bla ma zhal rnam pa gnyis po 'di/ gsang sngags rab 'byams la bka' drin che ba yin gsungs nas/ dad gus rgya cher mdzad do/ /mdor na gangs can gyi khrod na yod pa'i bka' lung rab 'byams phal mo che gsan la/ gsan pa de rnams kyang rnam grangs gsog pa'i bka' thob/ lung thob tsam ma yin par nyams len bshad pa/ phyag len dang bcas pa re re la yang / dgos phugs ltar du dpyis phyin par mdzad pa yin no/

/gzhan yang / shangs pa'i 'jag pa byams pa dpal gyi bu chen bla ma mgon po rgyal mtshan zhes pa/ ston pa bzang bas 'jam dbyangs dkar po zhes su grags pa de dang / rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni rje'i zhal nas/ nub gcig gi rmi lam du/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta yid du 'ong ba gcig dang mjal/ des kho bo'i lag tu kā pa la mtshan dang ldan pa nya phyis kyi mdog lta bu 'od kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs pas bkang ba gcig byin pa rmis/ de'i sang nyin/ lam shor gcig la mon grog tu phyin pas/ de na/ glo bur tu bla ma dpon slob gnyis pa gcig phebs 'dug bla ma de'i zhal nas/ gdang rmi lam du byung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ji lta ba bzhin du 'dug cing / yid yul du'ang 'bab par byung nas/ gang nas byon dris pas/ shangs nas yong gsungs/ gang du bzhugs rgyu yin byas pas/ da lta gnas gtsang 'di 'drar sdod med gsungs/ 'o na nged kyi brang khang du 'gro bar zhu byas pas byon ja bur gcig zhus pas/ kho tsho'i drwa ba'i nang nas pod chung mdzes po gcig 'dug 'di gang gis posti yin zhus pas/ kho bo'i thob yig lags gsungs/ 'o na lta bar zhu zhus pas/ lag tu gnang byung pa/ bltas pas/ sngar ma thob pa'i zab chos mang rab dang / khyad par mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i bka' zab cing rgya che ba gsan 'dug der gdang gis rmi lam de dran nas/ chos 'di rnams zhu dgos par 'dug snyam pa byung / 'on kyang theg chen chos kyi rgyal po chen po la mos gus ji 'dra yod dam snyam nas/ zhus pas/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po las chos mang po thos/ shin tu gus pa yod gsung gin 'dug der shangs pa'i chos bskor rnams gnang bar gsol ba btab nas/ gnang gin yod pa'i tshe/ nyin gcig bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi byin rlabs gnang / gtor ma yang bzang bar bshams/ zas sna du mas brgyan pa yod pa la/ dbyibs grub nas/ nged chos nyan rnams la gtor ma nas/

mtheb skyu zas sna tshang ba dang / bcas pa re gnang / khong pa rang mi bzhes par 'dug der drung pa rang yang bskul gcig bzhes par zhu/ zer ba zhus pas/ des 'phral thag re ring yod kyang / mtheb kyu zas sna dang bcas pa de tsho la gnang ba dang 'dra ba tshad ma gcig gtor ma la phar nas/ bla ma'i sku 'phang du song / der khye tra ba las der/ kho bo la skal ba gtod par gda' gsungs/ de nas dar gcig na/ gnam mthong na mar bya rog gcig gis sha lag pa g.yas pa bzang pa gcig skyur byung / 'di yang tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas la dmigs par 'dug gsungs nas/ thams cad la grangs de lta bu'i byin rlabs yod pa yin gsungs/ bla ma de'i drung du/ ni gu chos drug phyag rgya chen po 'chi med/ 'chug med/ ga'u ma ste/ shangs pa'i gser chos bzhir grags pa'i dbang / byin rlabs man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa rnams dang / su ka si dī'i chos drug bdag med ma'i nang 'khrid/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi skor/ kyai rdo rje mtshon bya can/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i chos bskor ma tshang ba med pa la sogs te/ mdor na mkhas grub khyung po'i bka' srol ma lus pa gsan cing / phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma dang / rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs la sogs pa mang po yang gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /de nas bar skabs su rje 'di nyid/ phyir mdo rgyud du ma'i mnga' bdag du gyur pa dang / khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srol dri ma med pa rnams la/ phul du byung ba'i snyan grags bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba'i tshe/ byang phyogs kyi mi'i dbang po sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen zhes bya ba/ spyir bstan pa rin po che'i bshad bsgrub kyi sbyin bdag rgya chen po mdzad cing / khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa la/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa bstan pa dang / ldan pa de nyid kyis/ rje 'di nyid kyi snyan ngag legs par gsan nas/ byang phyogs su spyan drangs te/

zhabs tog bdag rkyen yun ring khyad par grub chen blo gros bzang po 'di nyid/ rgyal ba brag phug pa chen po dang / bar na bla ma gcig las med pas rgyud thag nye/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bdag po yin pas/ gsung ngag gcig cis kyang gsan pas 'thad gsung nas/ rje de nyid kyi drung du/ gsung ngag rin po che lam skor dang bcas pa/ cha lag tshang zhing ma tshang ba med pa dang / gzhan yang / lam 'bras zhwa ma lugs ko brag bgegs sel ha skor dbang phyug chos/ brlan gyi bgegs sel la sogs pa'i/ bgegs sel rigs mi gcig pa du ma dang / bcud len gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'byung ba rgyun gcod la sogs pa man ngag mang po dang / mai tri mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang / sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro la sogs pa'i chos skor du ma gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad la/ rje'i zhal nas/ grub chen blo gros bzang po'i drung du/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bgegs sel sogs/ man ngag gi gnad du ma la/ blo skyed shin tu che bar byung bas/ bka' drin che ba yin gsungs/ dad gus che bar mdzad la/ grub chen de nyid kyang rje 'di nyid kyi lung rtogs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzigs pas/ rang las lhag pa'i sras su dgongs te/ rje nyid kyi drung du kyai'i rdo rje man ngag lugs/ ma rtogs rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang bas bka' babs pa dang / bde mchog lū nag dril gsum la sogs pa'i/ dbang bka' du ma dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang / rgya rtsa la sogs pa'i rjes gnang du ma dang / rgyud 'bum dang sa skya bka' 'bum la sogs pa'i lung gi rnam grangs du ma dang bcas pa grub chen de nyid/ slob ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po zhig dang bcas te/ legs par gsan nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par 'dzin cing / de'i tshe grub chen de nyid kyis thog grangs slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ legs par bshad pa du ma zhig kyang mdzad do//

//'dir smras pa/ sangs rgyas chos kyis sprin chen las byung ba'i/ dpag yas mdo rgyud man ngag chu bo rgyun/ /don bzang bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis legs par gtams/ /tshig 'bru bzang po'i sgra snyan ci yang sgrog /grangs nges rba rlabs phreng ba sna tshogs g.yo/ /nyes tshogs dri ma ma lus dag byed pa/ /mkhas grub gangs ri du ma las 'ongs pa'i/ /legs bshad chu phran du mas yongs bskor nas/ /bshes gnyen 'dzin pa'i 'jug ngogs legs rgyud de/ /yon tan rin chen 'bum phrag du ma'i gter/ /khyed thugs rgya mtsho'i khyon yang legs gtams nas/ /skal bzang chu bya'i tshogs kyi nyer 'tshor gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa bsgoms byung / rtogs pa'i yon tan 'bras bu dang bcas pa la/ rgyu nyams len ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul dang / 'bras bu yon tan ji ltar 'khrungs pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son nas/ thos bsam mdzad pa mtha' dag don yod par bya ba'i phyir du dben gnas 'ba' zhig tu/ sgrub pa lhur len pa mdzad de/ de yang bar skabs zhig tu/ grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras chen la sogs pa/ grub chen du mas nye bar brten pa'i gnas/ bu le'i gangs khrod du sgrub pa la bzhugs par mdzad de/ de'i tshul yang / rje 'di nyid kyis/ chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog legs pa la bka' gnang ba/ 'di ltar gnas kyi yon tan ni/ /rtsi shing la sogs 'dzoms par gda'/ /nyams dang rtogs pa 'phel ba'i gnas/ /gangs dang nye ring mtshams par mchis/ /rig pa dwangs chags 'phel ba'i gnas/ /brag dang gangs kyi mtshams na gda'/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis dben pa'i gnas/ /tho yang rlung dang rlung zil med/ /bying rmugs gnyid kyis dbang mi 'gro/ /ri dwags rnams kyang bde bar rgyu/ /snying rje ngang gis 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bya yang snyan pa'i sgra yang sgrog /nges 'byung gting nas skye ba'i gnas/

/ri gzar 'bab chu rwa bas bskor/ /brtson 'grus bogs 'don 'phel ba'i gnas/ /yon tan bdun ldan gnas mchog 'dir/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dpag bsam shing / /mthu ldan nyid kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag ni rtag tu skal ba bzang / /lus kyang zo mdog bde bar mchis/ /sems kyang ngang gis dngas par mchis/ /phyi nas rnam g.yeng nyung bar mchis/ /nang nas chos spyod brtson par mchis/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la yang zab cing rgya che ba'i thugs dam gyi rim pa du ma zhig gnang ste/ de yang tho rangs kyi cha la/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi 'od gsal las bzhengs nas/ thog mar 'gro ba sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis rab tu gdung pa rnams la legs par gzigs te/ de dag spyi dang bye brag la dmigs pa'i thugs rje rlabs po che bskyed nas/ gsung gdung ba'i smre sngags dang bcas pas spyan chab char bzhin du 'bebs cing / de'i ngang nas/ bla ma kho na la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro brgya rtsa la sogs pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi thugs bdag gzhan brje ba dang / mnyam pa'i tshul gyis rgya cher bsgom par mdzad do/ /de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa'i phyogs la/ kyai'i rdo rje/ bde mchog gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ mai tri mkha' spyod la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang me tog phog pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor du ma la brtson par mdzad cing / rdzogs rim gyi phyogs la/ 'khrul 'khor/ rlung sbyor/ thig le'i rnal 'byor/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor/ bde ba bsgom pa/ lta ba skyong ba la sogs pa du ma dang / bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor lam dus kyi dbang thun bzhir bzhes pa/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang bir bsrung la sogs pa bka' rgyas btab pa 'ga' zhig dang / de dag gi yan lag khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang / lha de dag gis bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor du ma zhig dang /

gtor ma la yang nang gtor gyi phyogs la/ yi dam dang chos skyong gi gtor ma du ma dang / rgyun gtor la/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i dzam ser nag dkar cha bzhi/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ kha 'bar ma'i brgya rtsa/ dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gtor ma nyi shu rtsa bdun/ gzungs gtor gyi rim pa lnga/ cha gsum gtor ma/ de dag gi bar skabs su chu sbyin du ma dang bcas te/ sa lugs kyi gtor ma'i rim pa rnams dang / sbyin bsreg dang / gshin po rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga dang / skabs dang 'tshams par kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang / mthar lam 'bras phyag mchod mdzad nas/ gzims pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par mdzad cing / de'i tshe yang / rmi lam dang 'od gsal 'dzin par mdzad de/ de ltar rgyun gyi thugs dam de dag ni/ bshul lam thag ring po la 'byon bzhud mdzad pa dang / chos rigs mi gcig pa du ma gsung ba dang / dkyil 'khor mi gcig pa du ma'i sgrub mchod mdzad pa dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs cha du ma gnang ba dang / dbang bskur rgya chen mdzad pa la sogs pa/ thugs brel rgya chen po ci byung yang / 'chag med du mdzad pa yin no/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ yongs 'dzin nyi ma'i zer gyis legs bskyangs byams dang snying rje'i chab kyis rab bskrun byang sems sa bon las 'khrungs pa/ /rnam dag lta ba'i rtsa ba rab bstan rim pa gnyis kyi gdong chen legs rgyas rnal 'byor brgyad kyi yal gas mdzes/ /rnam g.yeng rlung gis g.yo ba mi mnga' grub pa brgyad kyi me tog rnam bkra sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /'khor ba'i bshul ring 'khyams pas dub pa'i 'gro tshogs kun gyi bsti gnas gyur pa yongs 'du'i dpag bsam khyod nyid tsam/ /zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa 'bras bu yon tan ji ltar 'khrungs pa'i tshul la/ gtso bor rang rgyud smin par mdzad pa dang / gtso bor gzhan rgyud grol ba'i mdzad pa gnyis/

dang po la/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul ji ltar brnyes pa'i tshul/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis bka' nyan pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul ni/ sku gzhon nu'i dus rgyud gsum gyi slob gnyer mdzad pa'i tshe/ mtshan gcig gi mnal lam du/ dkon khang bla brang gi tshom chen gyi phug gi gzims khang sgo lho bstan de na/ phrug 'bol dkar po chen po gcig gi steng na/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan dbu se yo re bzhugs 'dug phyag 'tshal byin rlabs zhus/ mos gus mdzad nas/ bdag gi ma rgan yang byin rlabs zhu ba la bos na khyab lags sam/ zhus pas/ khyab gsung / 'bod du byon pas khrom du song zer nas ma rnyed/ slar log nas byon pas/ rje btsun sngar bzhin 'dug der rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i gnad zab la rgyas pa mang po gsungs/ khyad par de dag gi don dril ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' zhig gsungs pa'i snang ba byung / mnal sad pa na/ thugs la khra lam me 'dug phyi rab thug gi bar la tshigs bcad rnams thugs la yod pa yin ste/ yi ger bkod pa ma byung bas/ da lta mi gsal bar 'dug ces/ dbon po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa la gsungs 'dug gzhan yang rje nyid kyis zhal nas/ snga mo'i dus/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na/ dbu rtse ma'i g.yab chen na/ khri yug ring po gcig gi steng na/ rje sa skya pa chen po 'phags pa rin po che'i bar/ rje btsun gong ma lnga po gral rim gyis bzhugs 'dug pa dang mjal/ mos gus tshad med pa byas/ der kho bos/ rgyal ba'i yul na rgyal sras sbyin pa dpal/ /'phags pa'i yul na dpal ldan bir+wa pa/ /kha ba can na kun dga' snying por grags/ /sa chen bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar khrod na mi thub zla ba'i zhabs/ /bod yul dbus na dpal ldan bsod nams rtse/ /sa steng 'di na mkhyen rab dbang por grags/

/slob dpon rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser mdog can na mi dbang 'khor lo bsgyur/ /mi mjed zhing 'dir dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dpal ldan rgyal mtshan dpal/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams zhing na 'jam pa'i dbyangs su grags/ /mngon dga'i zhing der dri ma med pa'i dpal/ /byang phyogs 'di na lnga rig paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra bsgyur khrod na dpal brtsegs bsrung bar grags/ /gangs ri'i 'od ldan khrod na sa ston ri/ /dpal ldan sa skyar 'khon gyi tshul bstan pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zer ba'i bstod pa byas nas/ rim pa bzhin du phyag 'tshal ba rmis gsungs/ dus phyis bul rong du sgrub pa la bzhugs pa'i dus/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bla ma phal che ba'i zhal mthong / khyad par rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa chen po gsal bar mthong / zhes 'ga' zhig la gsungs 'dug go /yang rje'i zhal nas/ kho bo gzhon nu'i dus/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ sbyor drug zhus nas bsgom gyin yod pa'i dus/ srog rtsol gyi skabs su sleb/ dmigs pa zhu ba la phyin/ 'khor nas khang par sleb rtsa na/ gdong na dkon khang nas chas kha gcig pa'ang bskyal 'dug chang tshad gcig 'tshod du bcug pa'ang de nub sleb byung pa dang / kho bo yang lo gzhon pas/ de nub dmigs pa bsgoms pa ma byung par/ nged grogs mched dpon slob gsum yod pas/ me gcig kyang sbar bza' btung byas zho lung 'tsho kha'i rnam thar la sogs pa gleng mo mang po byas/ sang snga dro dmigs pa la mno bsam btang bas/ cher ma brjed 'dug 'on kyang 'khrid bskor ba byung dus/ blo bsdur yang byas/ dmigs pa la dri rtog mdzad du byung na/ zhu rgyu yod snyam pa byas nas/ dmigs pa spod du phyin/ chos grol ba dang byin po phyag 'tshal nas gyes song / dpon chen a mo gha'i sras po/

rje btsun pa dang bshibs nas yod pa/ nged gnyis pos dang phyag phul nas 'gro grabs byas pas/ kho bo la sdod gsung gin 'dug rje btsun pa yang sku gzhon nu las med pas mnyam por bzhugs 'dug pa la/ khyed rang song gsungs nas khong pa thegs song / de nas kho bo la/ kha sang gi dmigs pa skyor dang gsungs/ bskyar pas dmigs pa rang 'ga' brjed pa mi 'dug ste/ 'di ma brjed pa gcig pus mi chog bsgom dgos pa yin gsungs/ cung zad bsgoms lags zhus pas/ de ka yod/ mdang khyed gsum po sa cha 'di 'dra na/ sdod lugs 'di bzhin byas/ bza' btung 'di 'dra byed/ gleng mo 'di 'dra lab kyin 'dug pa de bzhin byed pa min/ da phyin chad legs par bsgoms gsung byung / der zhal lta gnang ba rnams mdang gi lag len byas pa dang gcig tu 'grig chad lhag med par byung bas/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po la thugs shes thogs med du mnga' ba'i nges shes gting tshugs pa skyes/ shin du mod lags zhes zhus nas/ phyag 'tshal nas phyin/ sleb ma thag chos rjes sgrib med du gzigs pa des/ thugs nas byung dgos pa'i 'jigs cha dang bcas nas/ de ma thag sgom khang du zhugs nas bsgoms pas/ ring por ma thogs par 'byung bzhi'i rlung gis kha thog dang / tshad so sor gsal ba byung gsungs/ gzhan yang lam 'bras gsung ba'i tshe yang / de bzhin bsgoms na 'di lta bu'i lam rtags yong ste/ kho bo la lam 'bras rang bsgoms pa'i dus ni ma byung / bsgoms sbyor drug bsgoms pa'i dus byung / zhes dang / yang / skabs 'ga' zhig tu/ kho bo lam 'bras pa mkhas pa yin/ sbyor drug pa nyams myong can yin/ ni gu ba rgan po yin zhes kyang gsung ngo / /dus phyis lha khang chen mor/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi 'khrid gsan pa'i tshe/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas 'di lta bu byung bar snang ste/ de yang 'od gsal ston pa'i rgyud tshig dka' gnad can gcig gi skabs su/

'bru non mdzad pa na/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i drung nas bshad pa mdzad pa la/ de bzhin ma yin/ 'di ltar ngos ma lags sam zhus pas/ chos kyi rgyal pos kyang gong du gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan rigs dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs/ rje nyid kyis kyang rang nyid kyi dgongs bzhed lung rigs kyis brgyan nas/ rgyas par zhus/ zhu ba dang zhus lan mang du byung / chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i bka' bkyon gyi rnam pa yang mang du byung ba la/ de nub tho rangs kyi cha la chos kyi rgyal po chen po gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal gzigs nas/ rgyud kyi don khyod kyis bshad pa ltar min khos zer ba ltar yin zhes gsal bar gsungs/ de dus mnyam du rje nyid kyis kyang gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal gzigs nas rgyud kyi don ni khyod kyis go ba de kho na'o/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs nas gzengs bstod par mdzad do/ /de'i sang snga mor rje nyid kyi slob ma a khu rin chen 'od zer sku drung du byung ba la/ rgyu mtshan rnams zhib par gsungs nas/ gzhan du gsang ba'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /de nas dmigs pa zhu ba la/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i drung du phyin pas/ rje nyid phyag 'tshal nas gral du bzhugs long med pa lta bu la/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i mdun bsu nas zhal lta gnang / kha sang gi rang re gnyis pos bshad pa de khyed zer ba ltar yin pa 'dug kho bo la de bzhin yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yi dam gyi lung bstan gsal po byung / khyed rang la yang lung bstan yong rgyu yod gsungs/ bstod bkur bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad do/ /zhes thos so/ /gzhan yang rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ nā ro mkha' spyod 'di yi dam byin rlabs can mtha' yas pa gcig yin/ kho bo gzhon pa'i dus gsang sngags la ye mi gus pa gcig yod/ de dus kho bo'i slob dpon mkhas grub kun bzang pa de/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshes bcu ma chag par mdzad kyin 'dug

'di la phan yon ci yod pa yin zhus pas/ gnas skabs mkha' spyod 'khrid pa dang / mthar thug sangs rgya ba yin gsung / mkha' spyod de ji lta bu lags zhus pas/ 'di ltar yin gsung / zhib par gsungs pas/ kho bo yang dad par byung nas mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs zhus bsnyen pa mang po byas pas/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags mang po byung / de phyin gsang sngags la shin tu dad par gyur/ des na gsang sngags rab 'byams la longs spyad pas chog pa yi dam 'di'i byin rlabs yin gsungs/ 'dir smras pa/ bla ma yi dam thugs rje'i dri bzhon gyis/ /khyod thugs sgrib med nam mkha'i khyon yangs 'dir/ /'gal rkyen sprin tshogs mtha' dag dengs pa'i mthar/ /gzugs sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor legs bstan nas/ /byin rlabs lung bstan 'od stong drwa ba yis/ /som nyi'i mun pa mtha' dag drungs phyung nas/ /phun tshogs rtogs pa'i pad tshal rab rgyas te/ /yon tan bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gang bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul las ji ltar brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ rje nyid la mngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon par shes pa yang mnga' ste/ de yang rje 'di nyid kyi sku skye ba snga ma rgya gar du sku 'khrungs zhes gsung ba'i lo rgyus 'ga' yar logs su thos pa la brten nas/ rje nyid kyi drung du gsal bar zhu bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang ldan pa'i tshe/ dpal ngam rings su gsung ngag rin po ches thog grangs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i dus su/ 'khrid pa rnams la byin rlabs zab po gcig gnang ba'i tshe/ gral du kho bos gleng blang nas/ kun gyis gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rje'i zhal nas de ltar na slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba lan gsum thob cig kho bos bshad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab pas/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ ngas skye ba snga ma la rgya gar du skye ba bzung ba'i bag chags/

skye ba 'dir yang gzhon pa'i dus su yang yang gsal ba cig byung / rgas nas lan re tsam las gsal ba mi 'dug de yang kho bo gzhon nu'i dus/ gdong nag na yod pa'i tshe/ nyin gcig srog chags la 'tshe ba byed pa zhig mthong / de la snying rje dang skyo shas drag po cig skyes pas sad byed byas pa nas thog mar dran pa yin/ de yang gro mo nas shar lho'i phyogs su phyin pa dang nye ba na ri chung zhig gi rtse la kha shar lhor bltas te phyin pas/ rdo skas sngon po ring po zhig la 'dzegs pa na dgon pa yod/ de yang gtsug lag khang bzang po rten gsum dang bcas pa/ khyad par rgya dpe mang po yod/ dpe mdzod na rgya dpe glang po che'i khal gsum tsam yod pa yod/ nye bar mkho ba'i dpe cha ba la khri'i 'grams su 'jog pa la yang / rgya dpe che chung 'dres pa pusti brgya skor yod/ zang zing gi nor dpe cha khur ba'i glang po che gsum po dang / bse ru rdog po 'ga' zhig las cher med/ nga rang paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rab byung gi rten du yod/ slob ma yang paṇ+ḍi ta dkar ser bco lnga tsam gyis thog drangs pa mkhas pa mang po dang / rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa yang du ma yod/ sbyin bdag ka shi ka'i ras kyi thod 'ching ba'i rgyal po chen po dgu dang / rgyal phran mang pos thog drangs pa yod/ bdag po dkon mchog legs pa 'di yang de dus kyi sbyin bdag dpyad pa'i rgyal po chen po gcig yin/ khyed kyang de dus kyi slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta gcig yin/ gzhan yang de dus kyi slob ma dang sbyin bdag bod du skyes pa yang gcig re 'dug spyir gzhon nu bag chags gsal bar 'dug pas/ de dus bris pa'i lañdza dang / wa rtu la'i yi ge la sogs brtsam da lta mi thon 'dug gsung / des na de dus kyi mtshan ji ltar yin zhus pas/ mi gsal 'dug gsung nas bkas ma gnang / de dus zhu ba po mang po yod pas 'di tsam las mi gsung / gzhan yang 'jam dpal chu mig na/

chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i chos khri de la/ chos rje paṇa chen gyi rnam thar ri mor bris pa/ de nas mthong res kyis nga rang gis kha bcos byas nas bris pa yin snyam pa yang yang yong ba gcig yod/ de dus kyis kha bcos byed mkhan de yin par 'dug ces kyang gsung ngo / /mdor na rje nyid rang gzhan gyi gnas phra rags du ma sgrib med du mkhyen par shes par gyis shig gzhan yang thugs gtad pa na bar dor gnas pa'i sems can du ma dang / de gang du blangs pa yang gsal bar gzigs pa yin te/ mgur du mi dpon don grub 'das nas zhu ba ma sleb pa la/ rje nyid mdo phra na bzhugs dus dbang bskur gcig mdzad pa'i tshe/ glo bur du mchod g.yog pa la shin du zhal lta gnang nas gnyags mi dpon sku khams de grum thub gcig med pa 'dra/ mtshan byang bris/ zhor la dbang bskur gcig byas pa drag pa 'dug gsung / de ltar mdzad pas zhag gsum song ba na/ thugs dam 'dogs 'bul mkhan sleb pas thams cad yid ches par gyur pa dang / ngam rings su bzhugs dus/ gnyags mi dpon gyis nu bo dge sbyong chos 'dzoms bzang po la dge sbyor khyad 'phags yod na'ang 'phral gyi 'chi rkyen glo bur ba'i dbang gis/ bar do cung zad ma zin pa rje nyid kyi mnal lam du byung nas sdug bsngal gyi nyen pa'i rnam grangs du ma snyan du zhus nas gsol ba 'debs shing 'dug de'i mod la sngar gyi bag chags kyi rgyun brtan pas/ rmi lam yin/ sgyu ma yin/ zhes yang yang smra yin 'dug pa la/ zhal nas drung chos pa rmi lam ka yin pa gda' 'am legs par ltos dang / zhes gsungs nas dgongs pa gtad pa nas/ yud tsam zhig gang med pa gda' lags/ 'di rmi lam gyi snang ba min/ bar do'i snang bar gda' lags zer der ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas lus dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bskur mdzad/ dbang grol nas/ dbang yon la 'bul ba phra rags du ma zhig byas/ bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyabs pa bka' drin che lags so zhes zhu ba rmis gsung /

de'i sang nyin cho ga grol nas sku mdun du 'bul ba rgya chen po byas pas/ mnal lam du phul ba gong du lung bstan mdzad pa dang lhag chad med par byung bas/ der yod kun ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa dang / yang ngam rings su bzhugs dus rje'i zhal nas/ do zhag a khu ba de yang yang dran pa gcig byung / ched du gtad pa'i dge sbyor mang rab yang byas gang na skyes yod dam bsam rmi lam bzung nas bltas pas/ rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams rtsa kha bzang po yod sa gcig na/ ma he rgan tshon po gcig du skyes 'dug kho rang khams bzang dus nga dud 'gror skyes na yang / rtswa kha bzang po 'tsho ba gcig du skye las che zer ba gcig yod/ de bzhin byung 'dug ces rje nyid kyi yab kyi skye ba bzhes tshul/ dbon po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa la gsal bar gsungs pa dang / twa'i si tu rnam rgyal grags pa'i jo mo/ dpon mo nam mkha' dpal 'bum 'das pa'i mchod 'bul la/ rje nyid gdan drangs thugs dam gyi khongs su bcug pas mdang rmi lam du dpon mor khrus byas/ lha'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ phyag 'tshal nas bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyabs pa thugs la btags zhes zer ba rmis gsung / lha'i gnas su skyes pa'i lung bstan mdzad pas/ chos rje bka' lnga pa dang / rtse chen chos rjes kyang lung bstan mdzad pa dang / mthun par byung ba dang / lho pa a zhang dpal ldan 'das nas thugs dam la btags pa'i tshe/ mnal lam du 'og gi phyogs na/ lcags 'khar sgo med 'bar ba gcig gi nang na/ a zhang dpal ldan sreg gin yod pa yin zer/ cho nge drag po 'debs kyin 'dug pa rmis gsungs nas thugs dam ched du gtad pa mdzad kyin 'dug pa dang / yang mdang rmi lam du dwags po rnam sras rgya gar gyi yul du glang po che gcig du skyes/ rgyan bzang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa btab 'dug pa la kho bo zhon nas/ chu chung se ba gcig la 'gro yin 'dug pa rmis zhes gsung ba dang /

gnang sku gzhon nu'i tshe/ yum chen mo la bka' gnang ba na kho bo la gdul bya gcig yod na byang phyogs su yong sa 'dug mdang rmi lam du byang ngam rings yin zer ba'i grong khyer chen po gcig na/ kho bo rin po che'i khri gcig gi steng na 'dug pa la/ yul de'i rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo mang pos 'bul ba dang bkur bsti byed pa rmi zhes gsung ba lta bu mnal lam la bsnyad nas/ lung bstan pa du ma zhig gnang zhing / gzhan yang 'dar chos sdings kyi mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan pas/ dge sbyor byed dus kyis gnas sogs kyi zhal ta gcig zhus dus/ de bzhin mi yong pa 'di bzhin yong bar 'dug ces/ mnal lam la bsnyad nas gsungs pa rnams/ gsung ji lta ba bzhin byung bas mos gus shin tu brtan par byung zhes zer ba lta bu/ ma 'ongs pa gsal bar mkhyen pa'i mngon par shes pa mnga' ba yin no/ /gzhan yang dbon po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pas thog drangs pa rnams sam+pu ṭi'i slob gnyer mdzad dus/ khong rnams la slob gnyer 'phel po byung ma byung zhu mkhan med par rje nyid kyis ji lta ba bzhin dgongs nas/ bka' gnang ba'i lo rgyus mang du yod de mdor na dus gsum gzigs pa'i mngon shes mnga' ba yin no/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba yang mnga' ste/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ kho bo chos rgyal chen po'i drung na yod dus dbu rtse rnying mar sgrub mchod mdzad pa na/ dus 'khor dang gur rigs bsdus la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po bcu bdun bzhengs pa'i tshe/ mtshon 'grem gzhan byed du bcug nas/ ri kha'i skya ris yongs su rdzogs pa kho bos mtshan gcig la grub par byas pa yin/ zhes gsung ba dang / yos lo ngam rings su mgon khang bzhengs pa'i tshe/ lha khang ka gnyis ma che ba gcig ngos mtha' khyab pa la/ 'og tu keng rus dang thod skam gyi rtsig pa steng phyogs su g.yang gzhi'i bla re thod skam gyi kha nas 'phyar ba'i rgyu rlon gyi zla ldi dang /

mi mgo dang don snying gi 'phyang 'phrul du ma dang / de dag gi steng 'og gi bar du/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi g.yas su/ mgon po/ zhal bzhi pa lcam dral gyi phyag mtshan g.yon du dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud rgyal thod 'phreng can gyi phyag mtshan/ phyogs rnams su gnod sbyin lcam dral/ pu tra ming sring gsum/ sgo ma bzhi/ sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa/ gaṇ+ḍi las sprul khro chen brgyad/ dur khrod bdag po lcam dral rnams dang / gzhan yang sprul pa'i mkha' lding / bya nag khyi nag mi nag lce spyang rnams dang / spyan gzigs kyi/ rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag la sogs pa/ de dag re re la yang / nyams dang rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba'i gzugs du ma dang bcas pa/ rje 'di nyid kyis nyi shu dgu'i mtshan mo ja dkar po sbyor gcig gi bar la gzhi ma nag po'i steng du/ thod le dkor gyi phyag ris rdzogs par mdzad la/ de'i sang nyin nas brtsams te/ nyi ma lnga'i bar la/ lha ris mkhas pa bzhi bsags nas/ dkar ris rnams kyi thog tu/ gser spyad dang / lha rnams kyi spyan 'byed dang / steng 'og gi rgyan rnams kyi mtshon byed rnams byed du bcug pa na/ 'bad pa chen pos rtsol ba bskyed de/ nam langs nas sa sros kyi bar du bri dgos pa byung zhing / de'i dus su chos skyong gnyan pa'i dbang gis/ lha ris pa rnams la rtsub 'gyur du ma thog mar byung yang / rje nyid kyis chos skyong la bka' bsgo ba mdzad pa tsam gyis zhi ba dang / rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe yang / bgegs bkrad mdzad pa na sa g.yo ba dang / mi yis ma byas pa'i sgra drag po dang / nye 'khor na gnas pa rnams la yang / mthong snang dang nyams snang mi 'dra ba du ma zhig byung ba dang / gzhan yang thugs khrel du ma 'joms pa'i tshe/ mchod g.yog pa so so la bka' bsgo ba mdzad de/ la las rgyun gtor bshams/ la las dus tha ma'i cho ga zhu/ la las gzigs tog mdzad pa'i phyag dpe 'bul ba sogs du ma zhig byed du 'jug pa/

mchod dpon de dag ni shin tu byang bar yod kyang / so so nas 'bad pa chen po byed dgos la/ rje nyid kyis de dag tshang la ma 'dres pa lhun gyis grub par mdzad do/ /'di dag gis mtshon nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar che ba du ma zhig mdzad par rig par bya zhing / rje nyid gang du phebs pa'i gnas de dang der/ dad pa dang ldan pa du mas dkyil 'khor chen po du ma'i dbang zhu ba glo bur du lhags pa na/ phal cher gzigs tog mdzad mi dgos par thugs las byung bas na/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob par gnang zhing / gzigs tog mdzad dgos re re tsam byung na yang / slob ma rnams khrus byed pa'i bar lta bu la yang / gzigs tog rgya chen grub yong gin gnang bas/ 'di thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi mdzad par mngon no/ /gzhan yang rje nyid kyi thugs kyi sras byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i zhal snga nas/ chos rje rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas phud a rag dang / sgog pa bzhes pa la/ skyur dri dang sgog dri gtan mi 'byung 'dug pas gzhan dang mi 'dra gsungs/ mos gus rgya cher mdzad par snang zhing / byi lo ngam rings du rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i bshad pa/ gsung ngag rin po che'i 'khrid/ rje btsun gong ma'i bka' 'bum gyi lung / dbang ka rigs mi gcig pa du ma dang bcas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i tshe/ rtsa rgyud kyi bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang / /rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa nyid/ /rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje can gyi chos 'chad do/ /zhes pa'i skabs su bshad pa rgya cher mdzad pa'i tshe/ me tog gi char kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa lta bu babs pa phyi nang du yod pa'i skye bo'i tshogs du mas rtsod med du mthong bas/ ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung zhing / rnam pa gzhan du yang / legs bshad ngo mtshar can mdzad pa dang / rab gnas mdzad pa dang / tshes bcu la sogs pa mdzad pa'i dus/

me tog gi char yang yang du 'bab pa mthong zhing / yul dus gzhan du yang de lta bu du ma 'byung ngo zhes kyang thos so/ /'dir smras pa/ dri med mkhyen pa'i chu gter dwangs par nyid kyis dge legs sngon nas chu shel dkyil 'khor dang / /gdul bya rnams kyi dus gsum skye ba'i rgyu skar phreng ma mtha' dag gsal bar rab 'char zhing / /bar srid snang srid 'ja' ris sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i rlung gis g.yo med mdzad pa'i chu rlangs can/ /rdzu 'phrul rlabs phreng chil chil rab g.yo dpag med yon tan bye ba'i 'byung gnas 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gsum pa mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis bka' nyan pa'i tshul ni/ 'di ltar bka' bstod chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis kyang / rje 'di nyid kyi bka' nyan cing / 'phrin las tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa yin te/ de yang sgo rum na bzhugs pa'i dpal gur gyi mgon po'i zhal 'bag sngon mtho btsun grub rjes rdo rje gdan du bzhengs pa bram ze mchog sred nas rim par brgyud nas/ mal lo tsā ba'i phyag du byon/ de nas rje sa skya pa chen po la/ chos skyong gi rjes gnang mdzad/ chos skor ma lus pa gnang nas/ nga rgas pas khyod mi dgos/ khyod rang 'khon sa skya pa'i rjes la song la bstan pa srungs shig ces gsung dus/ zhal 'bag nyid goms pa bdun gyi bar du 'phags nas/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i drung du byon pa/ de phyin chad nas bse 'bag nag po 'gro shes su grags pa de nyid/ 'phags pa rin po ches hor yul du 'byon dus phyag phyir chas pa la/ bla gos kyi sne mo dbu la bsnun pas/ 'bying pa yo ba'i rnam thar yod pa dpon chen byang rin gyi dus/ dngul bre chen gyi sgog stegs bcug pas/ dpon chen lkog ma bskrangs nas shi la thug pa byung pa/ dngul bre ston pas phan/ de lta bu la sogs pa shin tu gnyan pa'i rnam thar mang po yod pas/

gzhan sus kyang reg pa lta zhog gdong mig kyang lta bar mi nus pa de nyid la/ rje 'di nyid kyis/ zhal 'bag de'i rdul sel ba dang / nang gi phyogs kyi sgrog thag 'chos pa la sogs pa mdzad pa la rtsub 'gyur gyi rnam pa cung zad kyang mi 'byung zhing / dges pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma 'byung ba mngon sum du gsal ba dang / gzhan yang zhal nas/ ngas mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang zhus pa tsam nas/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa gcig byung na'ang / gtor ma snga phyi tsam la yang / mchod g.yog pa khrag skyug du 'ong ba sogs rtse reg rgod grags pa gcig byung bas/ 'jam par 'dod na lhag ma dang thug phrad la bslab zer ba'i man ngag de byas/ cung zad gnad la phab nas de phyin gtor ma/ ma chag tsam las ched gnyer ma byas kyang / 'bring 'tshams kyi mdo khrar phyi nang 'khor nas/ phyi res kha'u skyed lhas su yong pa na/ bsu ba byed pa la sogs pa dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mang po ston gyin 'dug pas/ de phyin tshes brgyad gtor ma yang ma chags par byin gsungs/ yang rje nyid ngam rings na bzhugs pa'i dus/ nyid kyi thugs sras kyi thu bo/ chos rje rin po che a nan+da pa'i drung nas shel dkar du bzhugs pa snyung du byung ba'i sku rim gtor bsgrub gcig mdzad pa'i dus/ mchod g.yog pa rnams gtor ma skyong du dong / rje nyid gzims khang na bzhugs pa cung zad mnal du song ba na/ a tsa ra nag po ras kyi thod bcings pa gcig byung / khyod su yin/ gsungs pas/ tsa tur mu kha yin zer/ gang nas yong gsungs pas/ da lta rang shel dkar nas yong zer/ 'o na chos rje a nan+da pa snyung ba ji 'dra yod gsungs pas/ kho ka na zer/ sems khral che che ltar 'dug da ji 'dra yong 'dri dgos snyam tsa na/ mchod g.yog pa rnams sleb nas gnyid sad byung gsungs/ yang yos lo rje nyid/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i sgrub gnas sku 'bum rnam rgyal na bzhugs dus/ sku khams bsnyel ba shin tu thu ba'i rnam pa stan/
