rlung ltas kyang bzang po mi 'dug gsungs/ thams cad 'jigs shing skrag par gyur pa na/ nub gcig gi tshe mnal lam du/ rje nyid rin po che'i khri gcig gi steng na bzhugs nas 'dug pa la/ zur bzhi nas mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bteg dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsu ba byas nas/ nam mkha' la gdan drangs nas/ 'og phyogs su gzigs pa na/ dbus gtsang gi sa cha sogs las rgal nas sngar gzigs ma myong ba'i zhing khams gcig gi steng na phebs 'dug pas da sa skya ji tsam na yod gsungs pas/ shin tu thag ring zer/ 'o na der 'gro dgos pa yod/ ma rgan mo drin can gcig yod pas/ de dang ma 'phrad par 'gro ba'i thabs med gsungs pas/ de'i mod la bram ze'i gzugs can mdog nag po mi rkang gi gling bu thogs pa gcig byung nas/ mkha' 'gro ma de rnams phyogs bcur bskrad nas drung du byung ste/ rnal 'byor pa'i a ma'i dad kha la/ da lan ngas bzlog yod do zer/ khyod su yin gsungs pas tsa tur mu kha yin zer ba dang mnal sad 'dug sang nyin sku rims gtor bsgrub pa rnams la mdang rmi lam 'di bzhin byung / mgon po chung ba la bskang gso dang gtor ma rgyas par phul gcig gsung / de dag rlung ltas dang thugs dam gyi ltas de ltar byung nas kyang / zhi bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel mgon po 'dis bsgrigs par mngon no/ /yang glang lo ngam rings steng du gsung ngag rin po che'i thog grangs chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor 'khrid pa tshan pa mi gcig pa du ma yod cing / khyad par ni gu zhu ba mang po byung nas/ gsung dus nub gcig gis tshe/ phyi rol na yod pa'i skye bo mang pos mthong bar/ byang gi phyogs nas rta pa lnga tsam gcig byung / rgya sgor rta babs nas gnyis rta'i gram du bsdad/ gsum nang du yong / yun ring ba gcig nas mthon byung nas/ rta zhon nas lam sngar gyi shul la log song ba mthong / de dus byang pa'i nang gi ma bde ba ma bsangs par yod pas/

pho brang phyogs nas zhal ta zhu mkhan 'dra yong pa yin nam zer ba'i dogs pa byung zer/ de nub rje nyid kyis gzigs snang la/ mi nag po dung gi sna cha btags pa gsum byung / gcig stag gi lpags pa gnyed legs pa byas pa'i gos gcig gon 'dug sku mdun du byung nas bsdad 'dug pa la/ dpon po de la khyod gang nas yong gsungs pas/ bsil pa tshal gyi dur khrod nas yong zer/ su yin gsungs pas/ sha ba ri pa'i slob ma gcig yin zer/ 'o na k+ṣe tra pa la yin nam gsungs pas/ yin zer/ gang la yong gsungs pas/ bla ma khyed kyis da lo spyir chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ khyad par ni gu legs par bshad pa thugs la btags/ da dung thengs gcig sa skyar 'byon bzhud ma mdzad par/ 'di kar thugs phobs la chos 'phro rnams mthar phyin pa mdzod/ nged rnams kyis kyang mthun rkyen bsgrub cing / 'gal rkyen spong ba'i zhabs tog byed pa lags zer de la sogs pa mang du zhus shing / yun ring du bsdad/ dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mang po byas nas song / sang nyin rje'i zhal nas mdang 'di lta bu byung rtse mor bshad na/ gdan sa la ma 'gro zer bgyil du yod pas ma bshad do/ /chos sdings rin po che pa 'di pa la rdod dkon mkhar gyi rgyud pa/ phyag drug pa'i bdag po yin pas/ khong pa gdan drongs la gtor ma rgyas pa gcig gtong du chug gsung nas/ de bzhin mdzad kyin 'dug yang ngam rings su bka' 'bum gsung ba'i dus su/ rje'i zhal nas/ kho bo lo bcu drug lon dus/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i/ sam+pu ṭa'i ṭīka chen 'dzin gin yod pa'i dus su/ nub ma mang po'i bar du rmi lam du bud med dkar mo ras kyis thod dkar ba bcings/ ras gos dkar mo gyon pa re mal gyi 'khris su nyal/ tho rangs gnyid sad khar phug ron rer byas kyin 'phur 'gro ba yang rmi/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i drung du/

'di bzhin byung ba ji ltar yin zhus pas/ de ṭī ka 'di'i chos bdag du dkar mo nyi zla bkod yod pas/ de'i rten 'brel yin gsungs/ sam+pu ṭa'i ṭīka chen 'di la thos bsam byed pa rnams la dkar mo nyi zlas grogs byed par 'dug gsungs/ mdor na de nas bzung ste/ sku dang grib ma ltar du 'grogs shing 'phrin las thams cad tshul bzhin du bsgrub par gnang ngo / /gzhan yang sku na phra mo'i dus nyid nas/ pu ṭa yang yang zhal gzigs pa'i lo rgyus mang du gnang zhing / rtsa gnas dwangs pa dang / rmi lam gsal ba mang po'i rmi lam du yang / rje nyid phyag phebs zhag shas kyi gong du pu ṭa yong nas gzims khang ni byi dor byed pa sogs byed kyin 'dug pa'i lo rgyus du ma yang snang / gzhan yang ngam rings su bzhugs dus phyag cung zad bsnyel nas/ gtor bsngo mdzad dus/ phyag dril mchod g.yog pas 'khrol dgos pa gcig yod pa'i tshe/ zhal nas da lta dur khrod bdag po byung / ka gdong 'di na bsdad nas gar stabs du ma byed/ khyad par dge legs dpal mgon dril bu 'khrol ba'i lad mo byed kyin 'dug gsungs/ mdor na mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad sku dang grib ma ltar 'grogs shing / 'phrin las thams cad 'bad med du bsgrub par mdzad pa'o/ /'dir smras pa rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa/ /bka' bstod srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bar chad kun sel bzhed dgu bsgrubs pa sogs/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las mtha' dag bsgrubs pa ni/ /gling bzhi 'khor lor dbang phyug bsgyur rgyal gyis/ /blang dor bzhed don phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /dpa' mdzangs ldan pa blon po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /sgo gsum gus pas rtse gcig sgrub pa bzhin/ /zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa/ gtso bor gzhan rgyud grol ba'i mdzad pa la/ bshad pa dang / rtsom pas grol bar mdzad tshul dang / gdams ngag dang byin rlabs kyis grol bar mdzad tshul gnyis/

dang po ni/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes nas/ gdan sa chen por rgyud gsum thugs la gsungs pa nas brtsams te/ mthar sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ma bstan gyi bar du gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya/ dpal ngam rings/ grub gnas chen po/ se mkhar chung / dben gnas rdo rje gdan/ rta zur rtse mo/ bu la'i gangs khrod/ chos grwa chen po mdar chos sdings la sogs par/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / skye bo'i tshogs du ma la/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang rigs gtad rjes gnang mdo rgyud 'brel pa dang bcas pa du ma'i lung / bshad pa lag len/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags phyogs kyi 'khrid rim du ma dang bcas pa ste/ gang la ci 'dod kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po yang nas yang du bskor ba mdzad cing de'i tshul phyogs tsam mtshon pa yang / rta lo dben gnas chen po rdo rje gdan du chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ tshigs su bcad nas/ chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog legs pa la bka' gnang ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ kha cig dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba cung zad zhi/ /la la las 'bras bslu med dang / /mi rtag gnas lugs bstan pa'i mthus/ /sgo gsum chos dang ngang gis 'dres/ /phal cher byams dang snying rje dang / /byang chub sems gnyis bstan pa'i mthus/ /gzhan phan 'dun pa rgyud la skyes/ /'ga' zhig mtha' bral lta ba'i gnad/ /bstan pas dngos 'dzin cung zhig zhi/ /gzhan dag dbang gi chu bo'i rgyun/ /bskur bas dam tshig thun bzhir gso/ /yang rab rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad/ /bstan pas nyams kyis drod ma yal/ /'ga' la rgyud sde zab mo'i gnad/ /bshad pas phyi nang spros pa chod/ /de ltar chos mthun brgya phrag lhag /so so thar dang byang chub sems/

/rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pas gdams/ /thun bzhir rim gnyis bsgoms pa dang / /thun mtshams bzlas brjod gtor ma sogs/ /phal cher gdams pas spros pa chod/ /la la rgyud la thos bsam bgyid/ /'ga' zhig sgom pas dus 'da' ba/ /zhing gi dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mi dbang nyid kyi mthu dpal te/ /dad ldan rnams kyi yin pa'i zhing / /'ga'i mchod pa'i yul yang lags/ /chos rgyal nyid kyi rim gro pa/ /de slad bsnyen cing bskur ba'i tshul/ /bzang zhing gya nom rab kyi phul/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag /bla na med pa'i mchod pa'ang de/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'ang 'di nyid yin/ /slar yang rjes su yi rang bcas/ /'khor gsum dag tu ma zhen par/ /rgya chen bsngo bas rgyas gdab bgyis/ /slar yang mi dbang chos skyong zhing / /chab srid chos bzhin bstan pa dang / /snyun med sku tshe ring ba dang / /byang chub mchog la gzhol bar shog /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de yang gong du smos pa'i gnas 'di dag ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya che ba bskor ba'i gnas yin pas logs su smos pa yin gyi/ yul dang grong khyer gang du phebs pa de dang der/ dbang dang man ngag la sogs pa'i bka' lung zhu ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yong zhing / de thams cad rang nyid gang 'dod pa'i chos kyi sbyin pas rgyud tshim par mdzad mod/ de dag gi rnam grangs ni su zhig gis bri bar nus/ gzhan yang phyi rabs kyi gdul bya grangs med pa la/ phan par mdzad pa'i phyir du/ bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ legs par bshad pa du ma zhig mdzad de/ de yang 'di ltar/ tshar gsum khug pa'i gsol 'debs/ thub pa'i dbang po dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa/ bir+wa pa'i bstod pa la sogs pa/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi bstod tshogs du ma dang / chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i rnam thar gnyis/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bzhag rgyud kyi mngon rtog bdag 'jug 'grel pa lugs kyi dkyil chog chen mo sam+pu ṭa'i ṭī ka

kyai'i rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ de'i bka' 'grel bsgom don dbang chu chen po'i bka' 'grel/ lag len 'khrul 'joms che chung lam dus dbang len tshul de'i bsgom don gsung ngag rin po che'i gegs sel/ kyai'i rdo rje ḍoṃ bhi lugs dang / mtsho skyes lugs kyi mngon rtogs nag po lugs kyi mngon rtogs dkyil chog gur rigs bsdus dang saṃ pu ṭi rdor dbyings kyi mngon rtogs mtshon cha can gyi mngon rtogs bdag 'jug 'grel pa lugs kyi dkyil chog chen mo/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi bsgrub dkyil/ bsdus don dang / mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ de'i phyag len gyi khrid yig dus 'khor sa chog sogs kyis zur 'debs/ dgra nag gi cho ga'i sdom/ gshed dmar lha lnga phag mo dbu spyad ma 'byung po 'dul byed rnams kyi mngon rtogs 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo grub pa'i rjes gnang / tshogs bdag gi rjes gnang / mgon po lha lnga ma/ lha brgyad ma/ lha bcu gnyis ma/ bcu bdun ma rnams kyi mngon rtogs dkyil chog dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud rgyal gyi gtor chog dus mchod ngos bzung / sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad cho 'phrul chen po'i rnam bzhag mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'phel/ bka' bcu pa dge legs dpal/ mnga' ris pa blo gros mtshungs med rnams kyi dris lan rnams dang / gzhan yang bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / sgrub pa pho mo dang / gdan sa bka' gros pa dang / sbyin bdag chen po rnams kyis ngor mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / man ngag dang / gdams pa spring yig la sogs du ma zhig gnang zhing / ding sang phyi mo ma rnyed pa/ kyai'i rdo rje gzhal yas khang gis gsal byed la sogs pa yang yod par snang ngo / /mdor na de lta bu'i legs par bshad pa re res kyang skal ba dang ldan pa'i rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin te/ dper na bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba lta ba pa ni/ mos gus rtse gcig tu byed pa bsgoms pa yin/

ci byas zhabs tog tu 'gro ba spyod pa yin/ byin rlabs lhun grub du 'byung ba 'bras bu yin/ don de bzhi tshang ba'i skal ldan kun/ bla ma bsgoms pa'i gdams pa de la mdzod/ ces gsungs pa tsam gyis sgrub chen ma seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi rgyud la rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa skyes pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar dri ma med pa'i bshad pa dang / legs bshad du ma zhig mdzad pa la brten nas rje 'di nyid la chos kyi bka' drin legs par nos pa'i slob ma du ma zhig 'khrungs te/ sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud/ bdag po slob dpon chen po kun dga' blo gros pa dang / slob dpon chen po bde legs bkra shis pa rnam pa gnyis dang / gsung ngag du ma'i thog grangs man ngag du ma'i mdzod 'dzin pa grub chen blo gros bzang po dang / yi dam gyi lhas byin gyis rlabs cing dngos grub brnyes pa chos rje rin po che a nan+da ta ma ti dang paṇa chen shākya shrīs gdan sa pa/ mkhan chen chos grub rgyal mtshan pa dang / sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa dang / yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen lung rigs rgya mtsho ba dang / mdo sngags rab 'byams kyi bdag po mdar chos sdings kyi mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dang / mkhas grub mgon po seṅge dang / gzhung rgya smra ba rat+na shrī dang mkhas pa'i dbang po bzad pa blo gros rgya mtsho dang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po dang / gzhan yang ngam rings chos sde'i 'khon rigs smra ba'i gtsug gi nor bu seng ge dpal rin chen dang / dgra bcom pa don bzang rgyal mtshan dang / mkhan chen blo bzang grags pa la sogs pa bshad sgrub kyi srol 'dzin pa du ma dang / grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chos rje bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pa dang / chos sdings rin po che dang /

ne rings rin po che la sogs pa/ sgrub rgyud kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa du ma dang / grub thob lcags zam pa la sogs rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa mang po yang byung zhing / rong mi bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / chos gling dbon po la sogs pa mdo khams kyi yul na yang / bu chen du ma zhig yod la/ mdor na dbus gtsang khams gsum mnga' ris dang bcas pa na/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa dang / rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / rgyud sde 'dzin pa dang / sde snod 'dzin pa la sogs pa bgrang gis mi langs ba zhig byung ngo / /'dir smras pa/ khyod sku lhun po yon tan gzi 'od can/ /slob ma'i tshogs kyi dbus nas bltams pa ni/ /gling bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /rin chen rdul rtsegs kun nas brjid pa bzhin/ /rgya chen chos sgra kun nas sgrog pa'i gsung / /tshangs dbyangs lta bur kun nas khyab pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags kyi chu 'dzin las/ /yan lag drug cu'i 'brug sgra sgrog pa 'dra/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i char rgyun mi zad pas/ /gdul bya'i log tog smin par mdzad pa ni/ /'phags pa'i yul du zas gtsang sras po yis/ /rim gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa gdams ngag dang byin rlabs kyis grol bar mdzad tshul ni/ rje 'di nyid kyi gdul bya'i skye bo rnams kyi bsgoms pa las byung ba'i gegs dang / bar chad kyi tshogs du ma yang byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs kyi sel bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang rta zur rtse mor thugs dam la bzhugs dus/ a khu rin chen 'od zer glo bur du tshogs drug gi rgyu ba 'gags te/ ro bzhin du gyur pa la/ rje 'di nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'di 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi rtsa rlung sems thim pa yin/ 'di la mi gzhan gyis reg na/ tshe 'di 'du byed pas ma reg cig zhes gsungs nas/

rje nyid 'khor dang bcas pas/ de'i mtha' bskor te/ thog mar ting bshags/ de nas dril bu/ de nas ḍā ma ru/ de nas se chal/ de nas rnga/ de nas dung sgra'i bar du sgra drag gzhan res 'jog du mdzad cing / lus sems la gnad du slad pas/ 'gog pa las slangs te/ ting nge 'dzin mchog brnyes par mdzad pa dang / yang a khu rin chen 'od zer la/ gnas sbyongs kyi nyams drag la yun ring ba gcig byung ba rje nyid kyi gsol ras gnang ba tsam gyis zhi bar mdzad pa dang / mdar chos sdings kyi mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan pas/ phag lo dge 'phel du chos zhu ba'i dus/ chos la 'dod pa ches par mngon pa'i zhu ba zhig phul/ spyir rje de khro ba'i rnam 'gyur ston pa mi mnga' ba la/ de nub kho rang gi snang ngor/ gsung sna thung bar mngon tsam gcig byung de nub khong la dmyal ba'i rmi nyams shin tu rtsub pa sdug bsngal can zhig byung / sad ma thag tu zhu ba cung ma bzo ba'i skyon yin nges snyam pa byung na'ang / sang nyin rje nyid la zhus pas/ nga la sems 'khrug pa cung zad kyang byung ba med de/ nyams de 'byams na skyon can yin mod/ lan gcig mi 'phar kha med yin pa la/ de tsam gyis gnas sbyongs kyi nyams 'char ba sgrib pa chung ba yin gsungs/ spyir bla ma yul gnyan yod/ khyad par gzhan dang mi 'dra bar 'dug snyam/ de phyin bla ma'i phyogs su dad gus kyi dran 'dzin bzang ba la shin tu phan par byung / zhes zer ba lta bu dang / yang rta zur du rgya mkhar bas/ rje nyid gdan drangs te phebs tshe dbang tshar mang ba zhig zhus pa'i dus/ rje nyid kyis chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i drung du bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub par/ gsol ba btab/ sman bsgrub re zhal gyis bzhes yod pas/ a ru ra gser mdog mang ba cig slong bar bzhed pa na/ mtshan gcig mnal lam du/ yul de'i gzhi bdag jo gdan chen po zhig gi rnam par byung nas/ chos 'brel zhig zhu zer de ltar na mdun du 'dug cig gsungs pas/

gdan zhig dgos zer gdan ji lta bu dgos gsungs pas/ 'di 'dra zhig dgos pa lags zer nas/ sran ma nag po'i g.yung drung ris gcig kho rang gis bris nas de'i steng du bsdad byung / der las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad mang ba zhig mdzad pa'i mthar/ jo gdan de na re/ nged la sngar dpal 'byor chen po yod kyang / dus phyis srab por song nas med/ bla ma khyed la a ru ra gser mdog la thugs bzhed che bar 'dug pas 'bul zer nas/ phyag 'tshal te song / de'i sang nyin nas dpal ldan mgon pos chos phyag la a ru gser mdog nyin re bzhin 'bul du byung ba dang / yang bu ler bzhugs dus/ bu le'i gzhi bdag gi zhabs tog dang gus pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma byas shing / nang zhig gzigs snang la/ gzhi bdag de sbrul chen po'i gzugs su bstan nas/ lus kyis bu le'i gangs la bskor ba gsum byas/ gangs kyi rtse las mtho bar sbrul mgo gdengs nas/ rje nyid bzhugs pa'i phyogs la 'dud pa'i tshul du 'dug pa dang / yang lan gcig sta zur du byon dus/ phyag phyi bas gzhi bdag gi rten dang / mdos la 'bags pa gcig shor ba la brten nas/ de nub rje nyid thugs dam la bzhugs pa na/ gzhi bdag de bstan pa'i gtso bo'i gser gyi sku chen po gcig gi rnam 'phrul du byas nas tho 'tsham du byung / rje nyid kyi yi dam gyi snying po zhig gsungs pas/ sku de'ang de'i lad mo byed kyin 'dug de nas rje nyid kyis bhir kha pa'i ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs nas/ de'i snying khar sdigs mdzub gtad pas/ thog mar de'i mig nas mchi ma byung / de nas mgo gting log de nas je chung song nas/ mthar jo gdan rid ngan ma zhig du byas te/ rje nyid la phyag 'tshal nas song gsungs ba dang / yang dbon po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa dbus na slob gnyer mdzad pa la yod dus/ bar chad kyi mtshan ma'i rmi lam shin tu rtsub pa byung yang / dngos su na tsha'am bar chad ci yang ma byung /

de dang dus mnyam du rje nyid shel dkar na bzhugs pa'i dus/ mtshan gcig gi mnal lam du mi gzugs chen po byad dmar po khrag gi mdog du yod pa gcig gis dbon po phang pas btab nas khyer song / rje nyid kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug la gsol ba btab/ mgon po che chung rnams kyang 'phrin las la bskul nas/ de'i phyi bzhin du gnyags nas/ mgyogs par byon pas/ rje nyid 'byon pa'i phyi la a tsa ra nag po dung long btags pa gsum yang rgyugs nas byung / lam bar na chu gcig 'dug pa la/ rje nyid 'khor dang bcas pas rdungs shing gcig la zam pa mdzad nas byon te ltongs gcig tu phebs pas/ da ci'i mi de ni gang na'ang mi 'dug dbon po ba rid ngan pa gcig de na skyur 'dug pa/ tshur khrid nas byon pa'i mnal lam byung / sang nyin mdang rmi lam byung / nyi ma rgyal mtshan la bar chad che bar 'dug pa/ kho bos skyabs yod 'on kyang rim 'gro 'di lta bu bya'i zhes gsung ba dang / yang phag lo gsos po rje nyid ngam rings su phebs dus/ mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan pas/ mkhar chung ko bar skyel thung la yong pas/ kho bo la dkar yol gcig gnang / de ka'i rjes la dkar yol de bzhes nas/ na bza' bla gos rnying pa gcig gnang / de nas byi phag gi mtshams su so ston 'jigs med grags pa'i sku'i skye ba shangs ston mgon po seng ge ba sku gshegs/ de nas rje nyid gdan sar 'byon pa'i lam du mkhan chen pa dang mjal bas/ khyed dpon slob kyi bar na dog cha phar pho tshur pho gcig yod pa chos gos de bzhag pas sel bar 'dug gsungs pas/ nges par de bzhin yin par 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes skyes/ spyir mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bla ma la re ba yin mod kyang / tshe 'di la mngon zhen ches pa'i mi la/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyab pa 'di rang yang bka' drin che bar gda' zhes zer ba lta bu dang / yang de nyid kyis lo/

kho bos bka' chen bzhi yi thog grangs/ pusti bcu gsum gyi gras bskor byed pa'i dus/ rgyal po'i bar chad kyi rnam pa'i rmi lam rtsub par byung / rje nyid la gsol ba btab pas/ mtshan gcig gi tshe/ mnal lam du 'di ltar byung gsung ste/ thog mar bro pa dang spre 'bag pa la sogs pa'i zang zing mang pos lung pa khengs 'dug pa/ dar gcig nas de thams cad rlung tshub chen po gcig gis phyogs bcur ded song ci yin dris pas/ gam na 'dug pa gcig na re/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i 'og rlung gis ded pa yin zer gyin 'dug de'i mod la mkhar rnga chen po bzon cung ma rdzogs pa gcig mdun na 'dug pa lag tu blangs nas brdungs pas/ dbus gtsang kun de'i sgras khyab pa gcig byung / gam na yod pa'i mi de na re/ mkhar rnga 'di mthar thon na mdo khams yan chad 'di'i skad kyis khyab pa gcig yong zer ba rmis/ khyed kyis grwa bskor bar chad med par legs par grub 'dug ces gsungs ba dang / yang sprel lo kho bos kyai'i rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi dbang bskur thog mar zhus pa'i tshe/ 'bul ba'i thog ma la tshe dpag med kyi gser sku gcig phul bas/ de 'phral du a khu rin chen 'od zer la gnang gin 'dug gting du a khu dang gleng mo byung bas/ kho bo mang po'i gong du rlung ltas log nas shin tu 'jigs par yod pa la/ kha sang tshe dpag med kyi sku de gnang ma khad la/ rlung ltas sor chud nas byung / khyed kyi 'bul ba de bdag la bka' drin che zhes zer gyin gda'/ gzhan yang kho bo gzhon pa'i dus brtson 'grus shin tu zhan par yod pa la rje 'di nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs/ thog mar mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang zhu dus/ sku byin rlabs can gcig gnang bas/ de phyin brtson 'grus 'phel nas/ sde snod kyi slob gnyer shin tu 'phel bar byung / yang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gcig gnang ba'i bka' drin gyis/

sngags phyogs la thos bsam byed pa na/ rgyud lung man ngag du ma thos shing / khong du chud la/ de dag gis zab mo'i gnad kyang / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes nas/ dad pa thob cing / mdor na rig pa'i gnas lnga dang / rjes su 'brel ba'i shes bya'i gnas rnams la/ rang gis nyams len ma nus pa ma gtogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma dang / slob dpon so sos kho bo la sgo skyel mdzad pa 'di ni rje btsun 'di nyid kyi bka' drin 'ba' zhig tu nges so/ /yang mus gle lung gi mkhan po chos kyi bde legs kyis rje 'di nyid kyi zhabs la gtugs nas/ rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pas thog grangs pa'i chos kyi bka' drin du ma nod/ gle lung gi gdan sar sleb pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i zhus pas/ khong gis rje'i sku lder gcig bzhengs nas rab gnas zhus pa'i tshe/ de ring khyod la rten 'brel bsgrig pa yin no/ /gsungs nas/ gdan mthon po gting / gos bzang po skon/ spyad pa bzang po dang tshogs 'khor gnang / mnga' gsol mdzad pas/ ring po ma thogs par gsol ba btab pa bzhin grub bo/ /yang ngam rings rtser bzhugs dus rje nyid kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i a rag gi gsol ras gcig slob dpon dge legs dpal mgon la gnang bar rtsom pa na/ nye gnas dar rin gyi sku mdun du slebs nas/ sngon la nye gnas la gnang nas yongs su rdzogs par 'thung / de nas dge legs dpal mgon la gnang bas/ bo nas tshang mar 'thung rgyu ma byung par/ rje nyid kyang thugs rtog cher mdzad gin 'dug nged gnyis po kho bo tshe ring zhing skyid par byung ba de'i rten 'brel yin zhes/ nye gnas zer ro/ /mdor na de lta bu'i tshul gyi gdul bya dpag tu med pa la mngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa'i rten 'brel du ma bsgrig par mdzad cing / tha na gsol ras tsam la brten nas kyang / mchog thun mong gi rten 'brel du ma sgrig par snang zhing /

myong bas grub pa dag kyang yod mod/ yongs su rdzogs par brjod mi nus pa'i phyir/ mdor bsdus pa tsam smras pa yin no/ /khyad par du yang / dpal ngam rings kyi gtsug lag khang chen por/ rje btsun byams chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi sku ngo mtshar ba/ 'gran zla bral ba 'di yang / bar chad med par myur du grub pa'i rten 'brel yang rje 'di nyid kyis bsgrigs pa yin te/ de yang / chos kyi rje sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i zhal snga nas/ chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog legs pa'i drung gnas la bka' bskul/ rgyal ba byams chen gyi sku phun sum tshogs pa bdag po'i drung nas rang gis dbu phang na ril le 'dug pa rmis gsungs/ bdag gi rmi lam du/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od rab tu 'bar ba gcig 'dug pa/ nam mkha'i dkyil du nub nas phyogs kun mun pas khyab par gyur pa rmis/ mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i rmi lam du/ rje nyid rgya yul du 'byon pa yin zer/ rje nyid kyi sku mi gnang bar/ phyag phyi ba rnams grabs shoms chen po byed kyin 'dug pa rmis nas/ rings par yong ste/ gdan bzhugs kyang phul 'dug gzhan yang bu slob so so la/ de lta bu'i ltas byung bar snang / rje de nyid mkhyen nas thugs rje rdzong na bzhugs pa'i dus/ nyin gcig phyag rdzas rags pa phal che ba gzigs/ de ring ni nyi ma rgyal mtshan yang bos shig gsungs nas/ dbon po ba gzims khang zur na slob gnyer la bzhugs pa yang gdan drangs/ de nas rje'i zhal snga nas/ khyod la yon tan rab 'byams sgor mor yod pa gcig re ba yin pa/ nga rang gis 'dod pa gu ru lugs bzhin ma byung na'ang / cha mthun byung / khyad par sgo gsum chos dang mthun po byung 'dug pa legs/ zang zing gi dngos po rnams kyi kha ta khyod kyis byed pa 'os na'ang / na ning gi slob gnyer la gnod kyi dogs nas ma bcol/ da 'di pa'i kha ta khyod rang gis gyis/

dpe cha lha rten 'di rnams khyod kyi nga'i chos kyi gdan sa zin du re ba yin pas/ khyod rang gis bdag bzung gyis/ zang zing gi dngos po gzhan 'di rnams/ dad rdzas gshin rdzas 'ba' zhig yin pas/ dge ba'i phyogs su thongs pa dang / khyad par jo bo'i sku tshad 'di/ nga rang gis 'dun pa drag po btang ba yin pas/ cis kyang grub pa gcig gyis/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs 'dug de nas sa lud du chab tshan la byon/ de ka'i steng nas gdan 'dren med par/ chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog legs pa la/ thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs nas ngam rings dang nye ba'i gnas dben par byon nas/ zhag bco lnga tsam bzhugs/ yon mchod mjal/ chos dang gsung gleng gis thugs rgyud tshim par mdzad/ der gsol ba btab nas/ thugs rje rdzong du res gcig bzhugs pa'i lugs su mdzad nas byon kyang / thugs rje rdzong du'ang ma byon par/ mdun du phyi bskor mdzad nas bzhugs/ de nas mdar du mgyogs par byon/ rtag rtog tu chab tshan mdzad/ der dbon po sangs rgyas dpal bzang mjal du yong pa la/ nga da lan gdan sar cis kyang yong ba la byed bde ba'i khyad yong pa 'dug pas/ gdan sa bka' gros pa la yang zhal ta zhus la/ 'bod mi yong ba'i bkod pa gyis gsungs/ de bzhin du mdzad de/ 'brug lo sos gdan sa chen por phyag phebs/ de dus chos skyong yang mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po byung zhes grags so/ /mdor na de dag ni/ sku 'bum rnam rgyal du bzhugs dus kyi mtshan ltas la dpags nas/ nges par gdan sar phyag phebs dgos pa dang / khyad par du yum chen mo la mjal ba'i phyir du sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs pa'i mdzad par nges so/ /de nas khrums kyi zla ba'i nyi shu lnga'i nyin bar/ dbon po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pas rje'i drung du/ mdang zhag gi mdar yas 'dren pa'i mnal lam tshun/ sku khams 'di ji 'dra yong lags sam/ zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/

rin po che bsod nams rtse mo dang / 'phags pa rin po che la sogs pa bla ma gong ma du mas sku tshe 'di 'dra bzhengs par rtsom pa na/ rje rin po che nyid dben gnas thugs rje rdzong na bzhugs pa'i dus rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gnang ba ni// ༈ //'di lta ste/ na mo wa gi shwa ra ya/ dngos grub gter 'dzin dkon mchog nor bu'i tog /dge dang legs pa'i gzi 'od rnam 'phro ba/ /nyid sku'i rgyal mtshan kun nas lham mer gsal/ /dpal ldan sa skyong skal ba bzang po rgyal/ /tshogs gnyis chu gter kun nas 'khyil ba'i klong / /dal 'byor rin chen khams las nye bar bskrun/ /che ba'i yon tan bdun gyis mngon par 'phags/ /chab srid gling bzhi'i dbus na brtan gyur cig /bdag gi snying kha'i chu skyes rab rgyas pas/ /dad pa'i dri bsung ngag gis gser nus bskyod/ /kun nas dge ba'i 'dab gshog rab rgyas pa/ /thugs kyi bung ba kun nas rol pa'i slad/ /bka' mchid zhu ba'i dar dir 'di skad lo/ /nyid sku bde'am dges par spyod lags sam/ /kun la phan pa'i gsung dbyangs bsgrags lags sam/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje kun la snyoms lags sam/ /bdag kyang khyed kyi thugs rje'i tsha zer gyis/ /bzhin gyi pad ma rab tu rgyas pa la/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan spro ba'i dri bsung g.yo/ /g.yo ba'i mig gi bung ba kun nas rol/ /khyad par skabs su bab pa'i zhu ba'i tshig /rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /bsod nams ye shes kun nas spel ba'i slad/ /bde gshegs sku gzugs rin chen las grub pa/ /kun nas 'dus pa'i dam bcas mthar phyin slad/ /zhu zhing gsol ba'i tshig 'di dgongs nas kyang / /gsol ba'i don 'di 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhu ba'i rten dang dad pa'i rten du ni/ /mi pham sku gzugs rol pa'i 'gying bag can/ /sku gzugs chen po myur du mthar phyin slad/ /lta bas mi ngoms mchog 'di nyid la 'bul/

/kun nas dge zhing dad pa'i nus mthu yis/ /ji ltar bzhed pa'i don rnams 'grub par shog /smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /dga' ba dang po'i tshes la zhus/ /zhes pa'i bka' shog dang / rje btsun byams chen gyi sku li ma shin tu mtshar ba gnang ba'i bka' drin gyis/ rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ bar chad kyi mtshan ma tsam yang med par shin tu myur bar grub pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ khyod kyi byin rlabs 'od stong drwa ba can/ /rtse gcig dad pa'i rta ljang gis drangs te/ gus pas gsol 'debs ljon pa'i gos bzang can/ /skal ldan shar ri'i rtse la shar ba na/ /bar chad mun pa mtha' dag drung phyung nas/ /log 'dren 'byung po'i bya tshogs long ba dang / /phun tshogs 'byung gnas kha ba'i rdul brtsegs las/ /dge legs chu rgyun ci yang 'phel ba dang / /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dpal 'byor rab 'dzin pa'i/ /blo gros 'dab stong ge sar 'bum phrag can/ /rgod pa bzhin du phyogs su lta ba rnams/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du byung bar gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gsum pa 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba mdzad pa ni/ de ltar zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i don legs par rdzogs par mdzad pas/ thugs tshim par gyur te/ zhing khams gzhan du gdul bya'i don rgya che ba la dgongs te/ gshegs par bzhed pa la/ nye bar gyur pa na/ chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog legs pa'i mnal lam du/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu bog zer ba'i sgra lhang pa gcig byung / gzigs pas las ma thub/ de'i tshod na tshe yang ring po yin/ der ma zad tshe tshad las kyang lo gsum gyis lhag pa thub/ de'i bar la yang mi tshe thos bsam sgom gsum dang 'chad nyan la bskyal ba yin pas/ 'gyod pa med/ da lan shi na yang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub mchod gcig byas nas/ mkha' spyod du 'gro ba yin mod/ ces gsungs/ de nas me pho 'brug gi lo/

khrums kyi zla ba'i nyi shu brgyad kyi nyin bar/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi rtag 'dzin bzlog par bya ba dang / le lo can rnams kyi brtson 'grus bskyed par bya ba la sogs pa dgos pa'i khyad par du ma zhig gzigs nas/ bla ma dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ 'da' kha ma'i man ngag zab mo la thugs rtse gcig du mdzad pa'i ngang nas/ bla ma dang yi dam dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsus te/ yon tan gyi 'od zer bye bas brgyan pa'i sprul pa'i sku nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid chos kyi sku'i nam mkha'i dbyings su thim par gyur to/ /de'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma zhig bstan te/ thog mar mkha' la sprin tshogs du ma 'khrigs pa'i ngang nas/ glo bur du nam mkha' g.ya' dag par gyur pa las/ me tog gi char dpag tu med pa babs shing / de'i mod la nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon gyi drwa ba dpag tu med pa shar nas thim zhing / slar yang 'char ba dang / khyad par du bla brang dge 'phel nyid nas/ 'ja' tshon sna lnga kha gsum du gyes pa gcig byung te/ gcig ni lha khang chen mo theg chen chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i gdung bzhugs pa'i gzims khang la zug gcig gi sne mo la rma bya'i mdangs kyi ri mo ltar kun nas bkra ba'i 'od 'khor dang bcas te/ nub kyi phyogs su song / gcig shar phyogs su song nas yun ring po'i bar du gnas pa phyi rol na gnas pa'i skye bo kun gyi mthong ba la sogs pa byung pas/ dgos pa'i dbang gi zhag 'ga'i bar du gsang nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rtsis su byas 'dug na'ang / phyi log na gnas pa thams cad kyis phyi log gi ltas las rtsod med du shes pa byung ngo / /de nas dbon po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pas zhal bkod mdzad de/ tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin par/ slob dpon chen po bde legs bkra shis pas thog drangs/ gdan sa'i tshogs chen por/

dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag brgyad du longs pa la/ mang ja'i bsnyen cing bkur ba/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten gang la gang 'os kyi che 'bul/ gral 'gyed kyi dngos po rnam par dag pa dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ tshes bco brgyad nas brtsams te/ gdan sa chen po'i dril thogs dge 'dun stong phrag lhag pa nyin gcig gdan drangs pa the ba'i zhag lnga'i bar du/ slob dpon chen po bde legs bkra shis pas gtso mdzad/ gu shrī chen po rnam pa gsum la sogs pas thog drangs/ bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzhi brgya lhag pas/ kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog gshed dmar/ kun rig la sogs pa'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams zhal phye nas/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang / slob dpon chen po bas thog drangs mchod mkhan phal che ba/ slob mar gyur pa sha stag yin pas/ gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ mchod 'bul rgya chen po bsgrubs cing / de dag gi thad du yang phyogs kyi slob ma yon bdag dang bcas pas kyang / 'bul ba gya nom pa byung ba la brten nas/ bsnyen cing bkur ba 'bul gnod rgya chen po dang bcas pa bsgrubs te/ mdor na 'di lta bu'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs bzang po 'di bas lhag pa/ da ni gdan sa pa'i gang zag lta zhog gdung rgyud rnams la yang mi 'byung zhes pa'i snyan grags phyogs bcur bsgrogs par byed do/ /de nas smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin bar/ dkon khang nas gdan sa chen po'i tshogs su gro dbar gyi bsnyen cing bkur ba 'bul ba dang bcas pa bsgrubs cing / sku gdung rin po che la zhugs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i cho ga rgyud sde nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bsgrubs nas rje nyid kyi gdung las bsgrubs pa'i sku gdung dang / chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i ring bsrel la sogs pa'i gdung ring bsrel byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba du ma dang / rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i gzungs dpag tu med pa'i snying po can rje rin po che de nyid kyi 'dra zhal can gyi sku tshab/

sku tshad dang bcas pa yang / rje nyid mya ngan las 'das nas/ zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i khongs su legs par grub pa yin no/ /de nas ngam rings na rgyal ba byams chen 'dzam gling rgyan bzhengs pa la/ bal yul nas bos pa'i sprul pa'i gzo bo de rnams yod pas/ dbon po bas ngam rings su byon/ ston pa thub pa chen po'i sku rgyab mtho dgu yod pa/ shin tu mtshar zhing byon legs pa'i mthar thug pa/ nang bzhugs de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyis thog grangs/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i ring bsrel dang / gdung dang dbu skra dang / na bza'i dum bu la sogs pa byin rlabs kyi rten dpag tu med pa dang / gzungs kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa/ rgyud sde'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bzhugs pas/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di nyid/ sbrul lo snron gyi zla ba nas brtsams te/ zla ba bzhi tsam la legs par grub te/ rje nyid kyi dus mchod khrums kyi zla ba'i nyi shu brgyad la/ dpal ngam rings kyi kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan sku bltams pa'i gzims khang 'tshal khang du/ rje nyid kyi thugs kyi sras kyi thu bo rig pa 'dzin pa chen po du ma'i dbus na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo ltar mngon par mtho ba sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi rje rin po che a nan+da ma ti'i drung nas zhal snga nas thog grangs rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis rgyud sde nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa mdzad nas/ rta'i lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba la/ gdan sa chen por phebs te/ dge 'phel bla brang du lha mi kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan dam par bzhugs pa yin no/ /mdor na thang ston chen mo dang / mchod 'bul dang / gdung zhugs la zhen pa dang / gzim mal gyi sku tshab kyi rab gnas dang / nang rten gyi rab gnas dang / gzhan yang dus mchod zla mchod rnams nam sgrub pa'i dus su/

kha dog lnga pa'i 'ja' 'od kyi drwa ba 'khrigs pa dang / me tog gi char chen po 'bab pa la sogs pa/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma yang yang du byung la/ khyad par du yang / thang ston gyi nyin bar/ rtsa ba shar lho'i mtshams du zug nas/ rtse mo sa phyogs gzhan rnams su khyab pa'i 'ja' skar/ shing lo ris kyi rnam pa can shin tu mtshar bas nam mkha'i khams khyab par gyur cing / gdung khang gis rtse nas 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga pa/ ka ba btsugs pa ltar drang por gnas pa'i rtse mo nam mkha'i thongs su mtho bar song nas bltar mi mngon pa dang / gdung zhugs la zhen pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag par gyur pa'i ngang nas/ gdung khang gi rtse nas/ du ba'i tshogs gyen du 'phyur ba nam mkha'i mthil du sprin gyi rnam par gyur nas/ de las 'khor lo dang pad+ma la sogs pa'i dbyibs kyi kha ba gdan sa chen po'i nye 'khor rnams khyab par babs pa dang / nang rten gyi rab gnas kyi tshe/ 'ja' tshon rigs mi gcig pa du ma'i dbus su gnas/ de'i steng gi drang thad du/ 'ja' tshon sna lnga gdugs kyi dbyibs 'di lta bu gnas pa dang / nang rten gyi gser sku chen po gdan sa chen por 'byon pa'i lam du kha ba chen po tshubs byung bas/ sku la kha bas gnod pa byung gi dogs/ dbon po bas thog grangs rnams thugs brel bar gyur pa na/ mtha' ma kun kha bas 'khor nas lha chen zhabs tog pa dang bcas pa'i 'byon lam du/ nyi ma gsal bar shar nas gnod pa med par gyur pa/ skye bo kun gyi mthun du grub pa la sogs pa du ma zhig byung bar snang ngo / /'brug lo de gdan sa pa dang / mi nyag yon mchod nang gzings pa'i dam tshig gi bsel gyis bsgribs nas/ gdung zhu ba'i dus nyid lha sku ring bsrel la sogs pa de ma thag tu ma byon kyang / gting du phul dus so sor slob ma dad pa can rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa las ring bsrel du ma zhig byon par snang zhing / 'ga' zhig gis ni/

kho bo'i sug par yang phebs so/ /de ltar mya ngan las 'das pa chen pos bstan pa'i rjes la yang / gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma du ma yang ston/ dbon po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa'i mnal lam du/ rje nyid kyi slob ma'i tshogs du ma zhig la/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ dbang bskur zab mo gcig gnang gin 'dug pa/ dbon po ba nyid kyis kyang legs par gsan pa dang / gzhan yang lam dus kyi dbang gnang bar rmis pa la sogs pa du ma byung bar gnang zhing / mi nyag chos dpal bya ba'i rmi lam du/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ khyod bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor lta bar 'dod dam zhes gsungs/ shin tu yang 'dod lags zhes zhus pas/ de ltar na kho bo'i phyi bzhin shog cig ces gsungs nas/ rje nyid gdan sa chen po'i nub phyogs su gshegs so/ /khong gis phyag phyir 'breng pas/ rje nyid gtsug lag khang bzang po gcig gi nang na/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor blos blangs chen mo gcig 'dug pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum la 'dzegs nas/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus su gshegs song ba rmis/ da dung gdan sa chen por sku skye ba bzhes pa'i rten 'brel yin pa 'dra zhes zer ba thos pa dang kho bos bsams pa na/ rje nyid 'khor lo bde mchog gi yul bstan pa yin par sems shing / gzhan yang gdul bya 'ga' zhig la/ bde mchog gi ngo bor bstan pa dang / rjes su 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma byung bar thos shing / mthong mdo rgyas par ni ma bris so/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub rir nye ba na/ /grib ma'i tshogs rnams mngon du 'ong ba ltar/ /khyod sku'i nyin byed nub la nye ba'i tshe/ /snga ltas grib ma mngon du lhag par gyur/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing / /dmigs med brtse ba'i 'od zer bye bas spros/ /thogs med nus mthus log rtog mun sel ba/

/bla med bla ma nam mkha'i nor bu de/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings su thim par gyur/ /de tshe gdul bya'i sa 'dzin khor yug tu/ /blang dor mi shes mun pa'i smag rum 'thibs/ /yid kyi nam mkha' sdug bsngal skar mas khyab/ /slar yang mya ngan tshogs sprin 'khrigs pa las/ /smre ngag 'brug sgra sna tshogs 'byin byed cing / /mchi ma'i chu rgyun phreng ba rgyun mar 'bab/ /lha yi tshogs rnams me tog char 'bebs shing / /'ja' 'od gur gyis nam mkha' 'gengs par byed/ /khyod ni yon tan phreng ba rgyu skar dag /rim par brjod pas mtshan mo 'das pa gyur/ /rjes su 'dzin pa'i mtshan rtags skya rengs dag /dad ldan so so'i blo yis nam mkha' la/ /shar bas yid kyis ngal stegs cung zad bgyis/ /slar yang dad pa'i blo mig dag pa yis/ /khyod sku'i nyin byed yang yang mthong bar smon/ /mdor na/ de ltar che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su 'khrungs kyang / khengs pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' ba dang / gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas rig pa'i gnas rnams thogs med du mkhyen cing / byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das par gyur pa dang / sdom pa gsum la shin tu gces spras su mdzad cing / nyes ltung phra zhing phra ba dang yang zhag du ma 'grogs pa dang / gzhung lugs gang gsungs kyang / gzhon nu nyid nas rig pa'i gnas rnams/ tshig nyung ngus don rgya chen bde blag du rtogs cing phul du byung ba'i go ba rnyed nus pa dang / rtsod pa mdzad pa ni/ tshig sdebs legs shing rna bar snyan la bzung sla ba dang / bshad pa dang / man ngag rab 'byams phyag len phra mo tshun chad gsal la ma 'dres par mkhyen cing / rlom pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' ba dang / rnyed pa dang / bskur bsti la chags pa med cing / log sgrub can gyi skye bo rnams la 'khon du 'dzin pa rdul tsam yang mi mnga' ba dang / rim pa gnyis la brtan pa thob cing / thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor zab mos dus 'da' ba dang /

bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du 'gyur na/ rang gi sku srog la yang ltos pa med par 'gro don mdzad pa dang / bla ma dang yi dam gyi byin gyis brlabs cing / lung bstan brnyes pas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa mngon du mdzad pa dang / khyad par du yang / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang / dbyer ma mchis pa rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pas/ de dag gis dgongs pa dri ma med pa/ gzhan lugs dang ma 'dres pa/ gsal la rdzogs par thugs su chud nas gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston par mdzad pa la/ 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba la sogs pa/ 'di lta bu'i rnam par thar pa re res kyang / kho bo'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid/ sku che ba'i yon tan gzhan las ches shin tu mchog tu gyur cing / ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar smos pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di dag kyang rje nyid kyis zhal snga nas/ cung zad thos pa dang / rang gi mthong ba dang yid ches pa'i grogs dag las legs par thos shing spyad pas/ dag par byas pa rnams/ sgro ma btags bskur pa ma btab par bris pa yin no/ /de'i phyir lha'i tshogs rnams kyis mngon par dga' bar gyur te/ rnam thar 'di 'bri ba'i tshe na/ sa chen po g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas bzang po yang byung ngo / /de bas na skal bzang dag gis yid ches par byos shig 'dir smras pa/ theg mchog yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes kyi mchog /mtshan nyid gsum ldan rdo rje slob dpon la/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyis nyin zhing du/ /zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal 'dud byed cing / /de yi ba spu nyag gcig mchod pa ni/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mchod dang bsod nams mnyam/ /de nyid mchod na rgyal ba kun mchod cing / /smad na de dag smad par rgyud las gsungs/ /de slad dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /yon tan brjod la mngon par spro ba bdag /rgyal ba kun 'dus rdo rje slob dpon gyi/

/rnam thar brjod la brtson pas phyogs par 'gyur/ /dad pa rgya mtsho'i nang nas byung gyur cing / /sdoms legs tshig gi zur brgya kun nas bkra/ /snyan grags gzi 'od phyogs bcur rab 'phro ba/ /rnam thar 'di ni yid bzhin nor bu yin/ /'di yi dge tshogs dri med chu rgyun gyis/ /thog med ngag gis dri ma dag gyur gcig /yon tan chu phran du ma 'du ba'i gzhi/ /kun mkhyen gsung gi rgya mtshor 'jug par shog /kun dga'i gsung rab dri med rtag snyan cing / /yid 'ong sku yi rgyal mtshan lta ba dang / /de yi 'phrin las dpal 'byor bzang po yis/ /rtag tu bdag dang 'gro kun skyong bar shog /'di nyid bskul zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub pa dang / /dad pas lta zhing snyan dang 'bri byed pa/ /de dag kun kyang bla ma'i lam mchog 'dis/ /'phral dang yun gyi phan bde grub gyur cig /de ltar mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje de nyid kyi zhal snga nas bka' drin tshad med pas rjes su bzung ba la brten nas/ bla ma'i yon tan phyogs tsam shes nas dad pa thob pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa/ dpal ldan chos skyong bzang pos/ rje btsun de nyid kyi thugs kyi sras/ sku'i dbon po yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dbon po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pas/ yang yang bskul zhing / blo gros bsdur ba'i grogs kyang mdzad cing / gzhan yang don du gnyer ba du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ sa pho 'brug gi lo dpyid zla rwa ba'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ dpal ngam rings kyi gtsug lag khang du grub par bgyis pa'o/ /yi ge pa ni rtsad bskor ba yin/ 'dis kyang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa phyogs mtha' dag tu rgyas nas/ sems can thams cad de'i go 'phang du skye bar gyur cig
